Cultivation Level 10 — Hollow Field

Action  
Range: 60 feet  
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere  
Duration: 1 minute  
Concentration: Required  
Cost: 5 Qi

Create a field where reality is thin and Qi struggles to maintain agreement with itself.

This is a Qi field empowered by Secret authority, not a Spirit Awakening Domain.

Inside the field:

- Ordinary sound is reduced to a whisper.
- Bright Light becomes Dim Light.
- Dim Light becomes Darkness.
- Teleportation and dimensional movement from a Source CL lower than yours fail unless you permit them.
- Hostile Cultivation Point costs increase by 1, minimum increase 1.
- Hostile creatures cannot regain Cultivation Points.
- Temporary Hit Points granted by hostile cultivation effects are halved.
- A hostile creature that activates a powered technique cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

A hostile creature makes a Charisma saving throw when it:

- Enters the field for the first time during a turn.
- Starts its turn inside the field.

A creature is affected once per turn.

Failed Save

Choose one Hollowing effect until the start of the creature’s next turn:

- Speed is reduced by 15 feet.
- One active Sphere talent is suppressed.
- Domain Armament movement and attacks are suppressed.
- It cannot begin Concentration.
- It cannot activate audible techniques.
- It cannot restore Hit Points.
- It cannot use teleportation or planar movement regardless of its Source CL unless it uses equal or higher Secret authority.

Successful Save

Choose one lesser effect until the start of its next turn:

- Speed is reduced by 5 feet.
- It cannot take Reactions after activating a powered technique.
- Its next Cultivation Point cost increases by 1.

Deepen the Hollow

Once per turn, when a creature bearing at least 2 Void Marks fails its save inside the field, spend 2 of its Void Marks to choose one major system:

- One Sphere.
- One Subpath.
- One Method.
- One Golden Core Form.
- One Nascent Soul feature.
- One Domain Armament system.
- One Foundation active system.
- One Path resource recovery feature.

That system is suppressed until the creature leaves the field or the field ends.

A target whose Source CL is at least 3 higher than yours may repeat the Charisma saving throw at the end of each turn, ending this major suppression on a success.

A target whose Source CL is lower than yours receives no automatic repeat unless another feature grants one.

tianxia.subpath.qi.void_touched_cultivat.player_text:
Cultivation Level 18 — Law of Nonexistence

Bonus Action  
Duration: 1 minute  
Cost: 8 Qi  
Limit: Once per scene

You partially withdraw from reality and carry a moving absence around yourself.

For the duration:

- Gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet and Hover.
- Gain Resistance to all damage except Force, Psychic, and Void.
- Move through creatures and nonartifact objects as Difficult Terrain.
- Pass through up to 10 feet of nonartifact, non-Secret solid material during one movement.
- Do not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- Void Step costs 0 Qi once per turn and has a range of 60 feet.
- Empty Palm can be used as a Bonus Action once per turn.
- Hollow Field is active in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on you without requiring Concentration.
- Hostile effects whose Source CL is lower than yours cannot target you unless their user perceives you through Void, Secret, Truesight, conceptual, or equivalent authority.
- A lower-CL hostile area effect cannot include you when another legal placement can exclude you.

You cannot end your turn inside a solid object.

If you would:

- Move to the nearest legal space.
- Take 5d10 Force damage that cannot be reduced by this Secret Law.

Return to Nothing

Once during the activation, choose one creature, Cultivation Asset, active manifestation, or object within 60 feet.

A creature must bear 3 Void Marks.

A creature makes a Charisma saving throw. An unwilling sentient item uses its wielder’s or its own Charisma saving throw.

Failed Save — Creature

The creature is removed from ordinary reality and placed in a featureless Void interval.

While removed:

- It is Incapacitated relative to the outside world.
- It cannot perceive or affect the outside world.
- The outside world cannot perceive or affect it except through equal or higher Void, Secret, conceptual, Samsara, or explicit interstitial authority.
- Its active non-Secret manifestations outside the interval end.
- Its durations continue to pass.
- It does not regain Cultivation Points.

Duration by authority:

- Target within 2 CL: until the end of your next turn. It may make a Cultivation Check against your save DC at the end of each of its turns in the interval, returning on a success.
- Target 3–5 CL lower: 1 minute, with no automatic repeat until the duration ends.
- Target at least 6 CL lower: indefinite until released, rescued, or restored by equal/higher authority.
- Target 3 or more CL higher: until the start of your next turn, and only if you also succeed on a Cultivation Check against its save DC.

When it returns:

- It appears in the nearest legal space to its departure point.
- Its current Cultivation Points become 0.
- Choose one active cultivation system. That system remains suppressed until the end of its next turn.

Successful Save — Creature

- Take 6d8 Void damage.
- Lose Cultivation Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus.
- Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- One active cultivation system is suppressed until the start of its next turn.

Manifestation or Object

A nonliving nonartifact target whose Source CL is lower than yours is erased immediately.

Against an equal/higher, artifact, Immortal, or Secret target:

- Make a Cultivation Check against its save DC.
- On success, erase one manifestation or suppress one artifact/Secret function for 1 minute.
- On failure, suppress it until the start of your next turn.

Empty Heart

While Law of Nonexistence is active, a creature cannot compel you to approach, recognize, name, or emotionally acknowledge it through an effect whose Source CL is lower than yours.

This does not remove your memories or prevent you from choosing to interact.

Bonus Action  
Range: 30 feet  
Cost: 2 Qi  
Limit: Once per turn

Disappear through a momentary absence and reappear in one visible or precisely known unoccupied space within range.

Void Step may cross:

- Creatures.
- Ordinary darkness.
- Ordinary smoke or mist.
- Up to 5 feet of nonartifact, noncultivated solid material when you know the destination space exists.

Trace of Nonexistence

Empty Passage

- Does not carry a Grappled creature unless another feature explicitly allows it.

CL14 — Nine Arts Convergence

Action  
Cost: Normal costs of both techniques, plus 2 Qi  
Limit: Once per scene

Choose two techniques you currently know or have prepared.

They must come from different Spheres, be Qi-powered, normally require an Action or Bonus Action, have a base Qi cost of 4 or less each, and have legal targets or origins when Convergence begins. They cannot be Secret, Legendary, permanent, strategic-scale, resurrection effects, or techniques creating additional complete turns or activations.

Convergence Procedure

1. Declare both techniques, targets, origins, and optional surcharges.
2. Pay both complete Qi costs and the 2-Qi surcharge.
3. Resolve the first technique completely.
4. Resolve the second if legal targets remain.
5. If the second no longer has a legal target, it fails and its Qi remains spent.

Principle Bridge

Before resolution, choose one bridge between the two techniques:

- Shared Origin: The second may originate from one legal origin of the first.
- Carried Movement: One target moved by the first may become a legal target of the second despite ending outside the second’s normal initial range, provided it remains within 60 feet of you.
- Transmuted Element: One damage type used by either technique becomes a damage type used by the other.
- Guarded Transition: After the first resolves, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 2 × Proficiency Bonus or move 10 feet without provoking.
- Sustained Pattern: If both require Concentration and qualify for Split-Meridian Focus, the first upkeep payment is waived.

Principle Bridge does not create extra attacks, extra targets, additional save instances, or item-property duplication.

Convergence Limits

- A technique cannot target itself as the source of a recursive activation.
- An additional attack cannot generate another additional attack.
- A Barrage cannot copy the second technique across every projectile unless the second expressly permits that structure.
- A weapon-delivered technique applies only to its first qualifying attack unless explicitly stated otherwise.
- Qi Technique Potency applies once to each distinct activation, not once per target or projectile.

Cultivation Level 10 — Split-Meridian Focus

You may maintain two Concentration effects simultaneously when all of the following are true:

- Both effects are Qi-powered.
- At least one comes from a Curriculum Sphere.
- At least one is a Tier 1 or Tier 2 technique, or an equivalent effect.
- Neither has a base Qi cost greater than 4.
- Neither has a printed duration longer than 1 minute.
- Neither is Secret, Legendary, permanent, strategic-scale, or a Spirit Awakening Domain.
- The two effects are not the same named feature.

Split-Meridian Upkeep

At the start of each of your turns while maintaining two effects, spend 1 Qi or end one of them immediately.

This upkeep cannot be reduced below 1 outside a feature that expressly removes it, is not part of either activation cost, and cannot be paid by a feature that pays only activation costs.

Concentration Failure

When damage or another effect requires a Concentration saving throw, make one save.

- On a success, maintain both effects.
- On a failure, both effects end.

If an effect automatically ends Concentration, both effects end unless it explicitly targets only one named effect.

Duplicate-Packet Restriction

Two Concentration effects cannot create an infinite or recursive loop. A persistent damage, healing, movement, resource, or attack packet produced by one effect cannot automatically trigger an identical packet from the other unless both Source Rules explicitly permit the interaction.

Action  
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you or your Oath-Ledger Domain Armament  
Duration: 1 minute

A Covenant must offer both a rule and a clear benefit, protection, right, or release available to creatures that accept it.

Acceptance

- A willing creature may accept when the Covenant appears.
- A creature that enters later may accept without using an action.
- A hostile creature accepts by explicitly agreeing or by knowingly claiming the Covenant’s benefit and remaining in the aura.
- A creature may reject the Covenant and receive none of its benefits. Rejection alone creates no Mark.
- A surrendered, lawfully sentenced, or Completely Subdued creature may be compelled to accept on a failed Charisma save when the Covenant represents clear surrender or confinement terms.

A bound creature gains a Breach Mark only when it knowingly violates the accepted Law. It gains a Fulfillment Mark when it meaningfully honors the Law under pressure.

Choose one Law:

Sanctuary Covenant

Benefit: Accepted creatures gain +1 AC against attacks made by another accepted creature and Advantage against forced hostility.

Term: Do not make hostile attacks, deal hostile damage, or force hostile saves against another accepted creature.

Guarded Passage

Benefit: Accepted creatures ignore Opportunity Attacks from other accepted creatures while following a declared route.

Term: Remain on the route and do not attack protected travelers, guides, or route Anchors.

Honorable Contest

Term: Do not knowingly harm the named class of civilians, surrendered enemies, healers, prisoners, wounded creatures, or Anchors.

Formation Duty

Benefit: Accepted allies gain +1 AC or +5 Speed while occupying their assigned Formation region.

Term: Remain within the assigned region, maintain the named role, and do not abandon the Formation without the stated release signal.

Forbidden Art Accord

Benefit: Accepted creatures gain Advantage on saves against the named technique, Sphere, damage type, weapon group, movement mode, or cultivation category.

Term: Do not activate that category within the aura.

Immediate Witness

Once per round, when an accepted creature fulfills or breaches the Covenant, place the appropriate Mark and invoke one CL6 effect without spending that new Mark. The Mark remains.

Action  
Area: 40-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on you or your Oath-Ledger Domain Armament  
Duration: 1 minute  
Concentration: Required  
Cost: 8 Qi  
Limit: Once per scene

A visible heavenly ledger, ancestral court, constellation of witness seals, or equivalent cultural expression fills the field.

For the duration:

- Every clear promise, surrender term, office declaration, covenant acceptance, fulfillment, and breach spoken or enacted inside becomes perceptible to you.
- A creature cannot conceal whether it understood and accepted a term through a non-Secret effect whose Source CL is lower than yours.
- Place one Fulfillment or Breach Mark per creature per round without using your Reaction.
- Spending an Oath Mark costs no Qi and may occur once during every turn, no more than once per turn.
- Recorded Oath rewards and sanctions can affect a target anywhere in the field.

Heavenly Confirmation

At the start of each of your turns, choose one accepted obligation active in the field and one party to it.

If the party is presently honoring the term, grant one:

- Restore 3d8 + your modifier Hit Points.
- Restore 2 Cultivation Points.
- Grant +2 AC until the start of your next turn.
- Move 15 feet without provoking.
- End one lower- or equal-Source-CL condition that directly obstructs fulfillment.

If the party is presently breaching the term, impose one:

- Remove 2 current Cultivation Points.
- Prevent Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- Move it 15 feet toward a required position or away from a forbidden one.
- Suppress the exact technique, item function, movement mode, or system used for the breach until the start of its next turn.

Final Witness

Once during the activation, choose one creature bearing at least four Fulfillment Marks or four Breach Marks.

An unwilling target makes a Charisma saving throw.

Fulfillment — Failed or Willing

Choose one:

- Fulfill one remaining ordinary payment, passage, protection, or delivery term through heavenly substitution when the required resource is present in the field.
- Restore all Hit Points and up to half maximum Cultivation Points.

- Suppress every technique and item function used to commit the breach for 1 minute.

Heaven as Witness enforces accepted or lawfully imposed obligations. It does not:

- Punish unrelated violence merely because it is harmful.
- Reward unrelated aid merely because it is generous.
- Infer an unwitnessed contract.
- Seize unpledged soul collateral.
- Replace Karma’s independent cause-and-consequence authority.

CL3 — Encoded Lock

Action  
Range: 30 feet  
Duration: 8 hours  
Cost: 1 Qi  
Target: One unattended object, opening, container, mechanism, written surface, or 5-foot section of terrain

Choose one Lock Pattern:

Sequence Lock

The target cannot be opened, activated, crossed, or manipulated until three observable elements are used in the correct order.

Counterweight Lock

The target functions only while a named weight, pressure, object, creature, or balancing condition is present.

Answer Lock

The target requires a spoken, written, gestured, or mentally presented answer to a question you encode.

Pattern Lock

The target requires arranging visible symbols, tiles, lines, colors, or components into the correct configuration.

Contradiction Lock

The target refuses the obvious method and opens only through a stated inverse, exception, or alternate use.

You must define a genuine solution when creating the Lock. The solution cannot require knowledge unavailable anywhere in the setting, an impossible action, a nonexistent item, your private unexpressed intent, or a Secret Law the intended users could not possess.

Discover the Lock

A creature examining the target can tell that a Puzzle is present when its passive Investigation or relevant Qi Sensing equals or exceeds your save DC. Otherwise it discovers the Puzzle after one failed ordinary attempt to use the target.

Solve the Lock

A creature adjacent to the target may use an Action and choose a Puzzle Method.

- Success: Learn one true clue or satisfy one step of the solution.
- Success by 5 or more: Learn the complete ordinary solution.
- Failure: The target remains locked.
- Failure by 5 or more: Suffer 1d8 + Proficiency Bonus Force or Psychic damage, or trigger one harmless but revealing misdirection chosen when the Lock was made.

Three accumulated successful clues allow a creature to bypass the Lock even without the intended Key.

You may maintain a number of Encoded Locks equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

CL14 — Fourfold Logic Lock

Action  
Range: 60 feet  
Duration: 1 minute  
Cost: 7 Qi  
Saving Throw: Intelligence

Choose one creature. On a failed save, apply two different Logic Locks. On a successful save, apply one until the start of its next turn.

A creature 3–5 CL lower gains one additional Logic Lock on a failed save. A creature at least 6 CL lower gains all four.

Road Lock

The target cannot willingly teleport, phase, become Incorporeal, or move through another creature’s space. Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet.

Solution Examples: Trace the actual route, move through three marked spaces, use a Route or Space authority, or identify the false boundary.

Meridian Lock

The target cannot spend more than Proficiency Bonus Cultivation Points during one turn and cannot recover Cultivation Points.

Solution Examples: Alternate between two Spheres, reverse circulation, use Medicine or Pressure Points, or expose the lock through Qi Sensing.

Technique Lock

Choose one Sphere, Subpath feature family, weapon-delivery system, Domain Armament function, or named technique used by the target during the current scene. It is inaccessible.

Solution Examples: Use a different legal system to create the same result, perform the technique’s motions in reverse, identify the encoded name, or use a counter-Sphere.

Core Lock

Choose one Golden Core Form, Nascent Soul function, Method, Foundation active system, transformation, or Path resource engine. It is suppressed.

Solution Examples: Route power through a different legal cultivation structure, expose the Core’s true rhythm, perform a Cultivation Check using the locked system’s governing discipline, or receive outside specialist assistance.

Solve a Logic Lock

The target may use an Action and choose one active Lock and one Puzzle Method.

- Success: Remove that Lock.
- Success by 5 or more: Remove that Lock and gain a Master Key against your Puzzle features until the end of the scene.
- Failure: The Lock remains, and the target takes 3d8 Psychic or Force damage.

At the end of each turn, a target within 2 CL of you or higher may attempt one Intelligence save, removing one Lock on success. A target 3–5 CL lower receives this save at the end of every second turn. A target at least 6 CL lower receives no automatic save but always retains the Action-based Solve procedure.

Sacrificial Solution

Before a Solve roll, the target may pay one price to gain Advantage:

- Spend Cultivation Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- Accept one level of Exhaustion.
- Destroy or relinquish a relevant temporary Cultivation Asset.
- Allow one other active Logic Lock to persist until the end of the scene.

The price is not a payment to you and creates no oath, contract, or Karma by itself.

---

CL18 — Palace of the Final Riddle

Action  
Range: 90 feet  
Area: 30-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder  
Duration: 1 minute  
Concentration: Required  
Cost: 8 Qi  
Limit: Once per scene

A shifting palace, board, labyrinth, archive, court, lockwork world, or geometric impossibility overlays the area. The Palace is a Puzzle Formation with one central Riddle Core and four visible Clue Nodes.

Riddle Core

- AC: Your Cultivation Save DC
- Hit Points: 10 × your CL
- Resistance: All damage until at least one Clue Node is solved or destroyed
- Immunity: Poison and Psychic damage
- Source CL: Your CL

Clue Nodes

Each Node represents one Method: Observe, Infer, Test, or Contradict.

- AC: Your Cultivation Save DC
- Hit Points: 4 × your CL
- Resistance: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from noncultivated attacks
- Immunity: Poison and Psychic damage
- Source CL: Your CL

A creature adjacent to a Node may use an Action and the Node’s Method.

- Success: The Node is solved and becomes inactive.
- Success by 5 or more: It is solved, and every ally in the Palace gains Advantage on its next Solve attempt.
- Failure: The creature takes 4d8 Force or Psychic damage and is moved 10 feet to a legal space chosen by the Palace.

Destroying a Node also makes it inactive, but causes 2d8 Force damage to every creature within 10 feet.

Enter the Palace

When a hostile creature enters for the first time during a turn or starts there, it makes an Intelligence saving throw.

- Failed Save: Gain one unresolved Final Riddle for each active Clue Node, maximum four.
- Successful Save: Gain one Final Riddle of your choice until the start of its next turn.

Each unresolved Final Riddle imposes one stage:

1. Lost Roads: Speed halved; no willing teleportation, phasing, or remote origins.
2. Broken Sequence: No Reactions; cannot repeat the same named technique on consecutive turns.
3. Closed Meridians: Cannot recover Cultivation Points and cannot spend more than Proficiency Bonus during one turn.
4. The Unanswered Heaven: Complete Cultivation Suppression under the shared rule.

A creature with fewer than four Riddles suffers only the first stages equal to its count. A creature always retains ordinary movement, speech, perception, and the ability to take the Solve action unless another effect removes them.

Solve a Final Riddle

A creature may use its Action and choose one active Clue Node’s Method.

- Success: Remove one Final Riddle from itself and count one success toward solving that Node.
- Success by 5 or more: Remove two Final Riddles and solve that Node immediately.
- Failure: It gains one additional Final Riddle, maximum four.

A creature can also earn a true clue by observing another creature solve a Node, identifying a repeated Palace behavior, or using an explicit Puzzle, Divination, Strategy, Formation, Name, Karma, or Conceptual authority.

Effect of Solved Nodes

For every inactive Clue Node:

- The maximum Final Riddles a creature can bear decreases by one.
- Every creature immediately removes one Final Riddle of its choice.
- The Riddle Core loses resistance against all damage.

When all four Nodes are inactive, the Palace ends.

Master Key

A creature that solved a Logic Lock through a success by 5 or more during the current scene, possesses an authorized Key you named when creating the Palace, or has already solved one Clue Node may use a Bonus Action once per turn to grant itself or one creature it can see Advantage on a Solve attempt.

Leaving the Palace

Leaving the area does not count as solving the Puzzle. At the end of a creature’s turn after it leaves and remains outside:

- Remove one Final Riddle.
- Repeat until all Riddles are gone on later turns.

If the creature re-enters before all Riddles are removed, its remaining Riddles return to full effect.

Puzzle, Not Seal

The Palace does not create direct Seal Pillars, chains, or an unconditional binding. Every stage is encoded through visible, interactable logic. Destruction is possible, but understanding the Formation is usually faster than overpowering it.

Bonus Action  
Duration: 1 minute  
Cost: 8 Qi

You become the moving center of a heaven-cutting saber storm.

For the duration:

- Gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet and Hover.
- Gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, and Force damage.
- Do not provoke Opportunity Attacks.

Once per turn, when you activate an authorized weapon-delivered cultivation technique through a saber-family weapon, declare Ten-Thousand-Cut Delivery.

Until the end of the turn, the technique may be delivered through every qualifying saber hit you make, including attacks from Hundred-Step Saber Procession.

For each delivery after the first:

- The target must be legal.
- Resolve any attack roll or saving throw normally.

A creature is affected once per turn.

Failed Save:

- 5d8 Slashing or Force damage.
- It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

Successful Save:

- Half damage.

Failed Save:

- 10d10 Slashing or Force damage.
- Knocked Prone.

Successful Save:

- Half damage.
- Remains standing.

The line:

- Deals double damage to objects, structures, vehicles, temporary barriers, Formation Anchors, and Cultivation Assets.
- Creates a visible cut through any destroyed section.
- Cannot cut an artifact or Secret boundary without a successful Cultivation Check against its save DC.

Cultivation Level 14 — Behead the Standard

You strike the node that makes an army more than a collection of individuals.

Action  
Range: Weapon reach, or 60 feet through your Halberd Domain Armament  
Cost: 5 Qi

Choose one target identified as at least one of the following:

- Primary Formation Anchor.
- Secondary Formation Anchor.
- Command banner or standard.
- Formation commander.
- Creature serving as an aura’s origin.
- Creature serving as a remote technique hub.
- Cultivation Asset coordinating other assets.
- Vehicle, platform, or artifact serving as a linked power core.

Make one halberd-family weapon attack or Halberd Domain Armament Attack.

Hit Against an Object or Asset

Deal:

- Normal weapon or Domain Armament damage.
- 8d8 additional Slashing, Piercing, or Force damage.

The additional damage:

- Is doubled against the selected object or asset.
- Treats ordinary Damage Threshold as 0.
- Ignores ordinary Resistance to Slashing, Piercing, and Force.

If the target is destroyed or reduced to 0 Hit Points:

- Every linked effect depending entirely upon it ends.
- Every linked effect with redundant Anchors is suppressed until the start of your next turn.
- Each surviving redundant Anchor becomes visible until the scene ends.

Hit Against a Creature

Deal:

- Normal weapon or Domain Armament damage.
- 8d8 additional Slashing, Piercing, or Force damage.

Failed Save: For 1 minute:

- It cannot grant an aura or Formation benefit.
- It cannot transmit command features.
- It cannot serve as another creature’s Remote Technique Origin.
- It cannot coordinate shared Reactions.
- Its linked Cultivation Assets act without commands and use their printed default behavior.

It repeats the saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success.

Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn:

- It cannot grant shared Reactions.
- It cannot serve as a Remote Technique Origin.

Decapitation by Realm

When the creature is 5 or more CL lower than you and fails its save:

- It does not repeat the saving throw during the first two turns.
- Any lower-CL linked structure for which it is the sole commander is completely suppressed during that time.

Hook the Heavenly Asset

After Behead the Standard hits, you may move the target up to 20 feet when it is:

- A floating Domain Armament.
- A banner.
- A mobile Anchor.
- A flying Cultivation Asset.
- A creature no more than one size larger than you.

Cultivation Level 6 — Break the Rank

You can use this when  You hit a creature or asset participating in a linked cultivation structure with a halberd-family attack, Halberd Domain Armament Attack, or halberd-delivered technique.  
Cost: 2 Qi  
Limit: Once per turn

Choose one link identified by Read the Array or visibly functioning through the target.

Examples include:

- A Formation benefit.
- An aura.
- A shared Reaction.
- A command connection.
- A remote origin.
- A banner benefit.
- A shared defense.
- A linked movement effect.

The target makes a Charisma saving throw. An unattended Anchor or asset uses its Source Rule; if it has no saving throw, compare Source CL as described below.

Failed Save

Sever the selected link until the start of your next turn.

While severed:

- The target neither grants nor receives the selected shared benefit.
- It cannot transmit commands, targeting, power, or movement through that link.
- It is not treated as adjacent or connected for the selected Formation procedure.

Successful Save

The selected link flickers until the end of the current turn.

During that time:

- It cannot provide a Reaction.
- It cannot reduce the Qi cost of another creature’s feature.
- It cannot transmit remote targeting through the target.

Source CL Against Assets

Lower Source CL

An unattended Anchor or asset’s selected link is severed automatically until the start of your next turn.

Equal Source CL

Make a Cultivation Check against its save DC.

Success: Sever it until the start of your next turn.  
Failure: Apply the successful-save flicker.

Higher Source CL

Make a Cultivation Check against its save DC.

Success: Apply the successful-save flicker.  
Failure: The link remains intact, but its direction and Anchor are revealed until the scene ends.

Drag from Formation

After severing a link, move the struck creature up to 15 feet to a legal space.

This movement:

- Does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures participating in the same severed structure.
- Cannot pass through a solid barrier.
- Cannot place the target inside an occupied space.

If the target is an immobile Anchor, move yourself up to 10 feet instead.

Action  
Origin: You or your Halberd Domain Armament  
Area: 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder  
Duration: 1 minute  
Concentration: Required  
Cost: 5 Qi

A field of severing lines, hooked currents, and broken command paths fills the area.

This is a Qi field, not a Spirit Awakening Domain.

Hostile Linked Structures

A hostile creature or asset participating in a linked cultivation structure makes a Charisma saving throw when it:

- Enters the field for the first time during a turn.
- Starts its turn inside the field.

A target is affected once per turn.

Failed Save: Until the start of its next turn:

- It receives no aura or Formation benefit from outside the field.
- It cannot transmit a shared Reaction.
- It cannot serve as a Remote Technique Origin for another creature.
- Its first Cultivation Point expenditure during the turn costs 1 additional point.
- It cannot teleport through a linked Formation route.

Successful Save: Until the start of its next turn:

- It cannot transmit a shared Reaction.
- It cannot serve as a Remote Technique Origin for another creature.

A creature not participating in a linked structure is unaffected by this saving throw.

Exposed Anchors

Inside the field:

- Formation Anchors, command links, banner channels, and remote-origin paths whose Source CL is lower than yours become visible.
- Against equal or higher Source CL, make one Cultivation Check against the structure’s save DC when the field appears.
- On success, reveal its active Anchors and links inside the field.

Three-Edge Mastery

While inside your Field of the Broken Array, once per turn choose two different Three Edges for one halberd attack instead of one.

The attack still delivers only one cultivation technique.

Break the Boundary

Bonus Action  
Cost: 2 Qi

Choose one hostile wall, ward, Formation boundary, aura edge, or field boundary intersecting your Field of the Broken Array.

Lower Source CL

Create a 10-foot-wide breach until the start of your next turn.

Equal Source CL

Make a Cultivation Check against its save DC.

Success: Create the breach.  
Failure: Reduce its benefit by one printed step inside a 5-foot-wide passage until the start of your next turn.

Higher Source CL

On a successful Cultivation Check, create a 5-foot-wide breach until the end of the current turn.

You identify an enemy’s entire linked system and tear every tendon at once.

Action  
Range: 120 feet  
Area: 60-foot-radius, 60-foot-high cylinder  
Duration: 1 minute  
Concentration: Required  
Cost: 8 Qi  
Limit: Once per scene

When the feature appears, choose one hostile linked cultivation structure you can perceive or have identified through Read the Array.

Examples include:

- A battlefield Formation.
- A banner network.
- A command aura system.
- A remote weapon array.
- A linked shield wall.
- A construct-control lattice.
- A distributed ritual.
- A vehicle or fortress power network.

Reveal the Army

All active participants, Anchors, links, command nodes, and remote origins of the selected structure inside the field become visible when their Source CL is lower than yours.

Against equal or higher Source CL:

- Make a Cultivation Check against the structure’s save DC.
- On success, reveal them.
- On failure, reveal the number and direction of concealed nodes but not their exact spaces.

Collapse Strikes

Choose a number of visible nodes up to your Proficiency Bonus.

A node may be:

- A creature.
- An Anchor.
- A banner.
- A Domain Armament.
- A Cultivation Asset.
- A command implement.
- A linked structural section.

Each creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.

Failed Save:

- 8d8 Slashing, Piercing, or Force damage.
- Its links to the selected structure are severed for 1 minute.
- It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

Successful Save:

- Half damage.
- Its links are severed until the start of its next turn.

Objects and assets take 8d8 damage without a saving throw.

The damage is doubled against primary Anchors and command assets.

Formation Collapse

After all Collapse Strikes resolve, determine how much of the structure remains.

All Primary Anchors or Command Nodes Broken

The selected structure ends immediately when its Source CL is no higher than yours.

Against a higher Source CL:

- It is suppressed inside the field for 1 minute.
- It may reconstitute outside the field or after the duration according to its own rules.

At Least Half of Primary Nodes Broken

The structure is suppressed throughout the field for 1 minute.

Outside the field, it operates only through surviving links that do not cross the field.

Fewer Than Half Broken

For 1 minute inside the field:

- All shared bonuses are halved, rounded down.
- Shared Reactions cannot function.
- Remote origins cannot cross the field.
- Linked Cultivation Point reductions do not function.

Broken-Array Territory

For the duration, hostile creatures and assets inside the field cannot establish a new linked cultivation structure without overcoming your severing authority.

Lower Source CL

The attempt fails.

No Cultivation Points are spent when the illegality is known before activation.

Equal Source CL

The creator makes a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.

Success: Establish the structure.  
Failure: The attempt fails and the cost remains spent.

Higher Source CL

The structure forms, but its links inside the field are visible and cannot reduce Cultivation Point costs.

General’s Hook

Once during each of your turns while the field persists, choose one visible linked creature or asset inside it.

Move it up to 15 feet.

An unwilling creature makes a Strength saving throw.

Success: Move it 5 feet instead.

This movement can pull participants out of aura ranges, break physical formations, or expose Anchors.

A halberd carries three answers: point, blade, and hook.

Spear Point

- Increase reach by 5 feet.

Failure:

- You know that a concealed link exists.

tianxia.subpath.qi.go_stone_cultivator.f.player_text:
Cultivation Level 10 — Capture the Group

You learn to turn encirclement into an actual cultivation prison.

Bonus Action  
Range: 90 feet  
Target: One creature Surrounded by your board  
Cost: 4 Qi  
Duration: 1 minute  
Saving Throw: Dexterity

A creature within 10 feet of four or more Stones has Disadvantage on the initial saving throw.

Failed Save — Captured

The target becomes Captured.

While Captured:

- It is Restrained.
- It cannot willingly teleport, phase, become Incorporeal, or use a spatial passage.
- It cannot move or originate a Domain Armament outside the boundary surrounding it.
- Its Cultivation Point costs increase by 1.
- It cannot use a feature whose sole function is movement without first succeeding on a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.

At the end of each turn, it may repeat the Dexterity saving throw.

A repeated save is made with Disadvantage while at least three contributing Stones remain.

On success, Captured ends.

Successful Save

Until the start of your next turn:

- Its Speed is reduced by 15 feet.
- It cannot willingly teleport.

Capturing Boundary

Record the Stones contributing to Capture the Group.

The capture ends early when:

- Fewer than two contributing Stones remain.
- The target leaves the closed boundary through an effect that explicitly overcomes the capture.
- You end it without using an action.
- The duration expires.

Break the Board

A Captured creature or its ally may attack, move, suppress, or destroy contributing Stones normally.

A creature may also use an Action to attempt a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.

On success, choose one:

- Suppress one contributing Stone until the start of the creature’s next turn.
- Ignore Restrained until the start of the creature’s next turn.
- Pay 3 Cultivation Points to ignore the increased cost and spatial restrictions until the start of its next turn.

This escape procedure is intentionally expensive and temporary.

tianxia.subpath.qi.go_stone_cultivator.f.player_text:
Cultivation Level 18 — Heavenly Board of Encirclement

Action  
Range: 120 feet  
Area: 50-foot-radius, 50-foot-high cylinder  
Duration: 1 minute  
Concentration: Required  
Cost: 8 Qi  
Limit: Once per scene

Place up to nine temporary Go Stones in legal spaces inside the field.

Each temporary Stone:

- May be Black or White.
- Has two different Shapes of your choice.
- Uses AC 18.
- Has Hit Points equal to 4 × your Qi Cultivation CL.
- Disappears when the field ends.

Your existing Stones inside the field join the Heavenly Board and receive the same AC and Hit Points if those values are higher.

The entire field counts as Claimed Territory.

Heaven Owns the Board

For the duration:

- You may move up to three Stones 20 feet during each of your turns without using an action.
- You may change the Shapes of any number of Stones once during each of your turns.
- Allies you choose ignore Difficult Terrain and may move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks at the start of their turns.
- Hostile creatures treat the field as Difficult Terrain.
- Hostile teleportation, phasing, Incorporeal movement, and spatial passage inside the field require a Charisma save against your Cultivation Save DC.
- Capture the Group costs 0 Qi once per turn.
- A creature Surrounded by four or more Stones has Disadvantage on all saves against your Go-Stone features.

Board Judgment

A hostile creature makes a Dexterity saving throw when it:

- Enters the field for the first time during a turn.
- Starts its turn inside the field.

A creature is affected once per turn.

Failed Save: Choose one:

- Its Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.
- Push or pull it 15 feet.
- It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- Its next Cultivation Point cost before the start of its next turn increases by 2.
- It cannot willingly teleport, phase, or become Incorporeal until the start of its next turn.

Successful Save:

- Reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.

Take the Entire Group

Action  
Target: One creature inside the field Surrounded by at least five Stones  
Cost: 5 Qi  
Limit: Once during each activation  
Saving Throw: Charisma

The target compares its cultivation authority against your board.

Target Source CL 6 or More Below Yours

It makes the saving throw with Disadvantage and receives no automatic repeated saves.

Target Source CL Within 5 of Yours

It makes the saving throw normally and may use the escape procedure below.

Target Source CL 3 or More Above Yours

It makes the saving throw with Advantage. On a failed save, it receives a repeated save at the end of each turn.

Failed Save — Heavenly Capture

For the remaining duration:

- The target is Restrained.
- Its Speed is 0.
- It cannot teleport, phase, become Incorporeal, or cross planar or spiritual passages.
- It cannot move its Domain Armament.
- It cannot recover Cultivation Points.
- Cultivation Point costs increase by 2.
- It cannot activate a Path, Subpath, Sphere, Recorded Art, Forged Technique, Immortal Art, Method, Foundation-active, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, or cultivated-item feature with a cost greater than its Proficiency Bonus.

A substantially weaker target may therefore lose access to most or all of its cultivation during the capture.

Successful Save

Until the start of your next turn:

- Its Speed is halved.
- It cannot teleport.
- Its Cultivation Point costs increase by 1.

Escape Heavenly Capture

A target entitled to an escape attempt may use its Action to choose one:

- Make a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.

- Travels along a visible legal path.

Range: 60 feet

- Immunity: Poison and Psychic damage

- Occupies no space.

Cultivation Level 6 — Shape the Board

Whenever you Place a Stone, choose one Shape for it.

The Stone retains that Shape until destroyed or replaced.

Binding Shape

A hostile creature within 10 feet of the Stone must make a Charisma saving throw before it willingly teleports, becomes Incorporeal, phases, or crosses a spiritual passage.

Failed Save:

- The movement or transition fails.
- Any action spent is lost.
- Cultivation Points and consumable costs are not spent unless the attempted feature says otherwise.

Successful Save:

- The movement functions normally.

A creature saves once per attempted movement.

Opening Shape

The first time during each turn that an ally enters a space within 10 feet of the Stone, it may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

This movement can follow a Board Line.

Pressure Shape

A hostile creature starting its turn within 10 feet makes a Strength saving throw.

Failed Save: Choose one:

- Push it 5 feet.
- Pull it 5 feet.
- Knock it Prone.
- Reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.

Successful Save:

- Reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the start of its next turn.

A creature is affected by one Pressure Stone per turn.

Veiling Shape

The Stone and Board Lines connected to it become visually inconspicuous.

A creature hostile to you must succeed on a Perception or Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC to identify the Stone or connected Lines before interacting with them deliberately.

Crossing a concealed Line reveals that Line to the creature until the end of the scene.

Meridian Shape

When a hostile creature within 10 feet spends Qi or another Cultivation Point, mark it with Board Pressure until the start of its next turn.

The next Cultivation Point cost it pays before then increases by 1.

A cost cannot be increased more than once by Meridian Shape during the same turn.

Sacrifice a Stone

Reaction  
You can use this when  A creature within 10 feet of one of your Stones takes damage, fails a saving throw, or would be forcibly moved.  
Limit: Once per round

Destroy that Stone and choose one:

- Reduce the triggering damage by 2d8 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier.
- Add your Proficiency Bonus to the saving throw, potentially turning failure into success.
- Reduce the forced movement by 15 feet.
- Move the creature 5 feet to a legal space without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

Cultivation Level 10 — Heart Transplant

You can move a Heart Aspect from one creature to another.

Action  
Range: 60 feet  
Cost: 5 Qi  
Targets: One donor and one recipient

The donor may be:

- A creature currently missing an Aspect you stole.
- A willing creature offering an Aspect.
- A creature carrying one of your stored Aspects.

The recipient may be willing or unwilling.

An unwilling donor or recipient makes a Wisdom saving throw.

Resolution

If every unwilling participant fails:

- Remove the selected Aspect from the donor until the end of the scene.
- Implant it in the recipient for the same duration.
- The recipient treats the emotion as genuine while present.
- It remembers that supernatural influence occurred unless a later feature alters memory.

If either necessary participant succeeds:

- The transplant fails.
- No Aspect is removed.

Directed Aspect

Choose one subject for the transplanted emotion:

- You.
- A visible creature.
- A known person.
- A group.
- An object.
- A place.
- A goal.

The emotion can influence decisions, but does not automatically grant complete control.

A transplanted Loyalty or Love can compel the recipient to protect the subject from immediate harm and avoid knowingly betraying it. It cannot force direct self-destruction unless the emotion is defining and a later feature permits it.

A transplanted Hatred, Fear, or Rage can strongly bias hostility but cannot force an illegal action when no valid target or path exists.

Heart Medicine

When used on willing participants, Heart Transplant may instead:

- Move debilitating grief into a prepared vessel.
- Restore courage stolen by another effect.
- Transfer calm to a panicked patient.
- Separate compulsive love from its target.
- Preserve a dying creature’s defining attachment for later restoration.

This can be legitimate healing even when the same technique is forbidden in hostile use.

Cultivation Level 14 — Rewrite the Inner Heart

You can make an emotional alteration lasting or indefinite.

Heart-Rewriting Rite

Ritual Time: 1 hour  
Range: Touch  
Cost: 8 Qi and appropriate ritual materials  
Requirement: The target is willing, helpless, Restrained for the complete rite, unconscious, or contained within a Heart-Sealing Formation.

Choose one Rewrite:

- Remove one Heart Aspect.
- Create one Heart Aspect.
- Redirect one defining emotion toward a new subject.
- Weaken one defining emotion by one grade.
- Strengthen one emotion by one grade.
- Create a permanent Heart Anchor.
- Seal one traumatic emotional trigger.
- Restore an emotion previously stolen by you.

An unwilling target makes a Wisdom saving throw at the end of the rite.

If its Source CL is higher than yours, it has Advantage.

If it is at least 6 CL lower, it has Disadvantage and does not receive automatic repeated saves.

Failed Save

The Rewrite becomes indefinite.

It remains until:

- You willingly reverse it.
- A Heart, Mind, Spirit, Karma, Dream, or soul-healing effect whose Source CL equals or exceeds yours removes it.
- A breakthrough or profound identity event overturns it.
- The target completes a specific printed recovery condition established during the rite.

Successful Save

The Rewrite lasts until the end of the next scene.

Identity Limits

Rewrite the Inner Heart can profoundly alter behavior and relationships, but it does not automatically:

- Replace memories.
- Grant skills or knowledge.
- Change a creature’s creature type.
- Rewrite a true name.
- Transfer a soul.
- Override a Secret Law or higher-authority identity Anchor.

It may still cause a creature to act very differently because its genuine emotional structure has changed.

Heart Scar

An unwilling target bears a visible spiritual scar detectable by Qi Sensing and relevant Mind or Spirit perception.

A healer examining the scar learns:

- That an emotional Rewrite occurred.
- The Source CL.
- Whether it added, removed, redirected, strengthened, or weakened an emotion.

It does not automatically reveal the original or new subject.

---

Bonus Action  
Duration: 1 minute  
Cost: 10 Qi  
Limit: Once per scene

For the duration:

- Sense the dominant Heart Aspect of every creature within 60 feet unless concealed by equal or higher authority.
- Steal the Surface Heart costs 0 Qi once per turn and may target up to two creatures.
- Maintain up to twice your Proficiency Bonus in stored Aspects.
- Use a Stolen Aspect without spending a Bonus Action once per turn.
- Emotional Pulse affects up to two targets in range.
- Tear the Anchor requires no Cultivation Check against a lower-CL effect.
- Heart Transplant costs 2 Qi and can move one Aspect among up to three creatures.

Heart Court

A 30-foot-radius emotional court surrounds you.

At the start of each of your turns, choose one Court Law:

Court of Courage

Allies you choose gain Advantage on saving throws against Frightened and Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Court of Grief

Hostile creatures subtract 1d4 from the first attack roll they make during their turns.

Court of Loyalty

Allies may use their Reactions to move 5 feet toward or protect another ally when that ally is attacked.

Court of Fear

A hostile creature entering or starting inside makes a Wisdom saving throw. On failure, it cannot willingly move closer to you until the start of its next turn.

Court of Calm

Allies gain Advantage on Concentration saves. Hostile creatures cannot activate Rage-, Fury-, Frenzy-, or comparable emotional escalation without succeeding on a Wisdom save.

Court of Hatred

Choose one hostile creature. Allies deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to it once per turn.

Steal the Defining Heart

Once during the activation, choose one creature in the Court and one defining Heart Aspect you can perceive.

It makes a Wisdom saving throw with Advantage if its Source CL is higher than yours and Disadvantage if at least 6 CL lower.

On failure:

- Remove the defining Aspect for 1 minute.
- Store it even beyond your normal maximum.
- Choose one active system directly sustained by that Aspect: Rage, oath loyalty, fear immunity, morale aura, companion bond, Heart Anchor, emotional Method feature, emotional Subpath feature, or another recorded heart-powered system.
- Suppress that system while the Aspect is stolen.

The target repeats the save at the end of each turn if within 2 CL of you or higher.

A target at least 6 CL lower receives no repeated save during the duration.

On success:

- The Aspect remains.
- You learn one vulnerability, attachment, fear, loyalty, or defining desire connected to it.

When the duration ends, you may return the Aspect or attempt to keep it.

Keep the Heart

To keep it, spend 8 additional Qi and make a Cultivation Check against the target’s Cultivation Save DC.

On success:

- The theft becomes indefinite.
- The target suffers the same recovery requirements as Rewrite the Inner Heart.
- You retain the Aspect until you implant, consume, release, or lose it.

On failure:

- The Aspect returns immediately.
- You take 6d10 Psychic damage that cannot be reduced by this variant.

Steal the Defining Heart does not automatically grant command over the entire target. It can remove the emotion that supported its choices, identity, and cultivation systems, which may be equally devastating.

Cultivation Level 3 — Kindled Hearth

Action  
Range: 30 feet  
Duration: 8 hours  
Cost: 1 Qi

Create a cultivated flame or empower an existing hearth, campfire, brazier, stove, cooking fire, lantern, or similar contained flame. You may maintain one.

Kindled Hearth Asset

- Size: Small
- AC: 13
- Hit Points: 3 × CL
- Immunity: Fire, Poison, Psychic
- Source CL: Your CL
- Light: Bright 15 feet; Dim another 15 feet
- Aura: 15 feet

Chosen allies in the aura gain Advantage against Frightened, environmental cold, and Exhaustion from exposure, and are immune to ordinary discomfort from cold, rain, or damp conditions.

The Hearth may ignite ordinary fuel, does not spread uncontrolled Fire unless permitted, cannot be extinguished by ordinary wind or rain, and can be suppressed or destroyed normally.

tianxia.subpath.qi.heaven_anvil_maul_cul.player_text:
Cultivation Level 6 — Earthshaking Blow

Action  
Origin: You, your wielded maul, or your Maul Domain Armament touching a solid surface  
Area: 15-foot-radius, 10-foot-high cylinder  
Cost: 3 Qi  
Saving Throw: Dexterity

Strike the ground, wall, platform, or another connected solid surface.

Failed Save:

- 5d8 Bludgeoning or Force damage.
- Knocked Prone.
- Pushed 10 feet away from the origin.

Successful Save:

- Half damage.
- Remains standing.
- Pushed 5 feet.

Damage becomes:

- 7d8 at Cultivation Level 11.
- 9d8 at Cultivation Level 17.

Broken Ground

The area becomes Difficult Terrain until repaired.

If the surface can be physically damaged, create one of the following:

- A crater up to 5 feet deep.
- A field of broken stone.
- A split platform.
- A fractured wall section.
- A buckled metal surface.

Earthshaking Blow deals double damage to:

- Objects.
- Vehicles.
- Structures.
- Temporary barriers.
- Formation Anchors.
- Cultivation Assets.

It treats ordinary Damage Threshold as 0.

Shock Through the Guard

A creature using a physical shield, projected shield, armor shell, or defensive stance has Disadvantage on its first saving throw against each Earthshaking Blow activation.

A creature immune to being knocked Prone remains immune to that condition but takes the damage and forced movement normally.

Hammer the Opening

After a creature fails its saving throw, spend 1 Qi to apply one Anvil Fracture.

A creature can receive one Fracture from each activation.

---

tianxia.subpath.qi.heaven_anvil_maul_cul.player_text:
Cultivation Level 10 — Hammer the Core Out of Rhythm

Your accumulated impacts can misalign the target’s internal cultivation engine.

Core Hammering

You can use this when  You hit a creature bearing at least two of your Anvil Fractures with a maul-family weapon, Maul Domain Armament Attack, or maul-delivered cultivation technique.  
Cost: 4 Qi  
Limit: Once per target per scene  
Saving Throw: Constitution

Choose one active or inherent cultivation system you can identify through Qi Sensing:

- Golden Core Form.
- Nascent Soul circulation.
- Domain Armament bond.
- Method.
- Foundation active system.
- Subpath engine.
- One Sphere channel.
- Path resource engine.
- Active Formation link.
- Another equivalent cultivated system.

Failed Save

The selected system becomes Misaligned for 1 minute.

While Misaligned:

- Its Cultivation Point costs increase by 2.
- It cannot restore Cultivation Points.
- It has Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws.
- A feature requiring precise internal circulation uses the target’s normal statistics but is visibly unstable.

At the end of each turn, the target repeats the Constitution saving throw, ending Misaligned on a success.

Successful Save

Until the start of your next turn:

- The selected system’s next activation costs 1 additional Cultivation Point.
- The target cannot recover Cultivation Points through that system.

Lower-CL Impact Authority

When the target is 5 or more CL lower than you and bears four Anvil Fractures:

- It makes the initial saving throw with Disadvantage.
- It does not repeat the saving throw until the end of its second turn after becoming Misaligned.

Structures and Formation Engines

Core Hammering can target a Formation Anchor, vehicle engine, artifact power core, or Cultivation Asset bearing at least two Fractures.

Against an unattended target whose Source CL is lower than yours:

- Misalign one active system automatically for 1 minute.

Against an equal or higher Source CL:

- Make a Cultivation Check against its save DC.
- On success, apply Misaligned for 1 minute.
- On failure, suppress one active property until the start of your next turn.

Tempered Recoil

While wielding a maul-family weapon or controlling a floating Maul Domain Armament within 10 feet:

- Gain Resistance to Thunder damage.
- Reduce Force damage by your Proficiency Bonus once per round.
- Gain Advantage on saving throws against being knocked Prone.
- Count as one size larger when resisting forced movement.

---

tianxia.subpath.qi.heaven_anvil_maul_cul.player_text:
Cultivation Level 3 — Heaven-Anvil Impact

Maul Conduction

When you activate a Qi-powered technique, you may deliver it through a maul-family weapon you are wielding when all of the following are true:

- You are proficient with the weapon.
- The technique targets one creature or one object.
- The technique has a range of Touch, 5 feet, or 30 feet or less.
- The technique has an instantaneous effect or applies its duration directly to the struck target.
- The technique does not create an area, field, separate asset, summoned creature, or location-based effect.

Additional Cost: 1 Qi

Make one attack with the maul-family weapon as part of the technique’s activation.

Miss: The technique is not delivered and its complete cost remains spent.

Hit: Deal the weapon’s damage, apply the technique, and resolve all saving throws and once-per-activation limits.

Maul Conduction applies only to the first qualifying attack unless another Source Rule expressly expands it.

At Cultivation Level 9, a bound Maul Domain Armament may deliver the technique through its floating attack.

Ring the Anvil

You can use this when  You hit a creature, object, structure, Formation Anchor, or Cultivation Asset with one of the following:

- A maul-family weapon attack.
- A Maul Domain Armament Attack.
- A maul-delivered cultivation technique.
- A Qi-powered feature expressly shaped as a hammer, impact, falling weight, or shockwave.

Cost: 1 Qi  
Limit: Once per turn  
Saving Throw: Constitution for a creature; none for an unattended object

Failed Save or Unattended Target:

- Deal an additional 2d8 Bludgeoning or Force damage.
- Apply one Anvil Fracture.

Successful Save:

- Deal an additional 1d8 damage.
- Apply no Fracture.

Additional damage becomes:

- 3d8 or 2d8 at Cultivation Level 11.
- 4d8 or 2d8 at Cultivation Level 17.

Fracture Pressure

Your maul attacks and Heaven-Anvil features gain the following cumulative benefits against a target bearing your Fractures:

| Fractures | Benefit |
|---:|---|
| 1 | Treat its ordinary Damage Threshold as reduced by your Proficiency Bonus. |
| 2 | It cannot apply a nonartifact physical shield’s AC bonus against your maul attacks. |
| 3 | Gain +1 on attack rolls against it, and subtract 1d4 from its first Concentration saving throw each turn caused by your damage. |
| 4 | Your maul attacks and Heaven-Anvil features ignore ordinary Resistance to Bludgeoning and Force damage against it. |

Fracture Pressure does not ignore Immunity unless another rule expressly permits it.

---

tianxia.subpath.qi.heaven_anvil_maul_cul.player_text:
Cultivation Level 18 — Heaven-Anvil Judgment

You manifest the authority of a celestial forge descending upon an unworthy vessel.

Action  
Range: 120 feet  
Area: 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder  
Cost: 8 Qi  
Limit: Once per scene  
Saving Throw: Constitution

A colossal hammer, anvil, meteor, or descending forge-image strikes the field.

Failed Save

The creature:

- Takes 12d10 Bludgeoning or Force damage.
- Is knocked Prone.
- Is pushed to the nearest legal edge of a 15-foot-radius crater.
- Cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn.
- Receives enough Anvil Fractures to reach four.

Successful Save

The creature:

- Takes half damage.
- Remains standing.
- Is pushed 10 feet.
- Receives one Anvil Fracture.

The Crater

The central 15-foot-radius area becomes a crater up to 20 feet deep when the terrain can be physically destroyed.

The complete 30-foot-radius area becomes Difficult Terrain.

Objects, structures, vehicles, temporary barriers, Formation Anchors, and Cultivation Assets:

- Take triple damage.
- Receive four Anvil Fractures.
- Treat ordinary Damage Threshold as 0.
- Ignore ordinary Resistance to Bludgeoning and Force from this damage.

Artifacts and Secret structures use their printed defenses.

Shatter the Vessel

Choose one creature that failed its save and one cultivation system you can identify.

Target 5 or More CL Lower

The system is Shattered Out of Rhythm until the scene ends.

While Shattered Out of Rhythm:

- It cannot activate.
- It grants no active benefits.
- It cannot restore Cultivation Points.
- Existing effects created solely by it are suppressed.

The target receives no automatic repeat save.

Target Within 4 CL of You

The system is Shattered Out of Rhythm for 1 minute.

At the end of each turn, the target makes a Constitution saving throw, ending the condition on a success.

Target Higher CL

Suppress one active benefit of the system until the end of your next turn.

A successful Cultivation Check against its save DC suppresses the complete active system until the end of your next turn.

Forge-Breaking Consequence

When Shatter the Vessel ends, the target suffers Core Ringing until it completes one of the following:

- A short rest involving uninterrupted meditation.
- A 10-minute repair procedure.
- Appropriate Medicine, Blacksmithing, Formation, or meridian treatment.

While Core Ringing persists:

- The first cultivation feature activated during each scene costs 1 additional Cultivation Point.

An effect whose Source CL is lower than yours cannot remove Core Ringing instantly; it may instead complete the required repair procedure.

Cultivation Level 14 — Hundred-Hammer Meteor Foundry

You turn a heavy weapon into a mobile siege battery.

Meteor Hammerfall

Action  
Range: 90 feet  
Cost: 5 Qi  
Saving Throw: Dexterity

Choose a number of impact points up to your Proficiency Bonus.

Each point creates a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder.

The cylinders may overlap, but a creature is affected by one cylinder per activation.

Failed Save:

- 6d8 Bludgeoning or Force damage.
- Knocked Prone.
- Apply one Anvil Fracture.

Successful Save:

- Half damage.
- Remains standing.
- Apply no Fracture.

A target at the exact center of a cylinder subtracts 1d4 from its saving throw.

Each impact point:

- Creates Difficult Terrain until repaired.
- Deals double damage to objects, structures, vehicles, Formation Anchors, and Cultivation Assets.
- Treats ordinary Damage Threshold as 0.

Meteor Hammerfall may originate from a floating Maul Domain Armament.

Impact Orbit

Your Maul Domain Armament gains a specialized Impact Orbit mode.

While in Impact Orbit:

- Its control range becomes 90 feet.
- Its movement becomes 40 feet.
- It may Hover regardless of physical weight.
- It cannot make an ordinary Domain Armament Attack.
- It may serve as the origin of Earthshaking Blow and Meteor Hammerfall.
- It counts as touching the nearest solid surface within 10 feet for Earthshaking Blow.

Switching into or out of Impact Orbit requires no action once during each of your turns.

A real bound maul remains the actual item and can be physically targeted, restrained, trapped, or suppressed.

Falling Anvil Interception

Reaction

You can use this when  A creature you can perceive within 60 feet moves willingly, teleports, or is forcibly moved at least 10 feet.  
Cost: 2 Qi  
Limit: Once per round

Move your Maul Domain Armament up to 30 feet and make one Domain Armament Attack against the triggering creature if it is within reach of the final position.

On a hit:

- Deal normal Domain Armament damage.
- Reduce the remaining triggering movement by 15 feet.
- The movement ends completely if reduced to 0.

Falling Anvil Interception cannot trigger itself or another additional attack.

---

tianxia.subpath.qi.heaven_devouring_blac.player_text:
Cultivation Level 6 — Digest the Broken Art

You can feed on a hostile technique when its structure collapses.

You can use this when  A qualifying hostile Qi-powered effect within 60 feet ends because:

- Its user failed Concentration.
- It was dispelled or suppressed.
- Its Anchor was destroyed.
- Its user reached 0 Hit Points.
- Its duration expired after it meaningfully affected you or your allies.

Limit: Once per round

Choose one valid damage type the effect dealt or was explicitly capable of dealing. Gain 1 matching Essence.

You cannot gain Essence from:

- A harmless technique ended solely to feed you.
- An allied technique.
- Repeated destruction of a renewable zero-cost Asset.
- An effect that never became active.
- A technique whose only damage was mundane weapon damage.

Defensive Digestion

Reaction  
You can use this when  You or one creature within 10 feet takes damage matching an Essence you hold.  
Cost: Spend 1 matching Essence

The protected creature gains Resistance to that one damage packet.

If it already has Resistance, instead reduce the packet by:

2d8 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier

You must perceive the triggering damage or know its principle through Qi Sensing.

Domain Armament Conduction

At Cultivation Level 9, a Cauldron-shaped Domain Armament may be the origin of Swallow the Residue or Defensive Digestion when the triggering target is within 10 feet of the Armament and the Armament is within your normal control range.

A consecrated or anti-daemonic effect that blocks the line between you and the Armament prevents this remote reaction unless your Source CL exceeds it.

---

CL18 — Heaven-Devouring Cauldron

You establish a mobile field that consumes hostile expenditure and refines it into battlefield pressure.

Action  
Range: 90 feet  
Area: 30-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder  
Cost: 8 Qi  
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute  
Limit: Once per scene

Create a Cauldron Anchor at the center.

Cauldron Anchor

- Size: Large projected Cultivation Asset and Anchor.
- AC: Your Cultivation Save DC.
- Hit Points: 5 × your Qi Cultivation Level.
- Saving Throws: Uses your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier and Proficiency Bonus.
- Immunities: Poisoned, Charmed, Frightened, Prone; Poison and Psychic damage.
- Resistances: Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from noncultivated attacks.
- Source CL: Your Qi Cultivation Level.
- Movement: Once during your turn, move it up to 20 feet without an action.

The Anchor is visibly Daemonic and can be targeted by anti-daemonic effects.

If it reaches 0 Hit Points:

- The field ends.
- You take 4d10 Force damage.
- Lose all Devoured Essence.
- Gain 1 Corruption.

Field Effects

The area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures.

A hostile creature that enters the field for the first time during a turn or starts its turn there makes a Constitution saving throw.

Failed Save:

- Take 5d8 Necrotic or Force damage.
- Lose 1 Cultivation Point.
- Cannot regain Cultivation Points until the start of its next turn.
- If it has no Cultivation Points, take an additional 2d8 damage.

Successful Save:

- Take half damage.
- Do not lose Cultivation Points.
- Can regain Cultivation Points normally.

A creature is affected by this entry/start trigger once per turn.

Feed on Expenditure

Once per round when a qualifying hostile creature in the field spends Cultivation Points, gain 1 Essence matching a valid damage type used by that activation. If it uses no valid damage type, gain Force Essence.

Cauldron Protection

Swallow the Art can protect an ally in the field when:

- You can perceive the ally.
- The ally is within 60 feet of you or the Cauldron Anchor.
- The triggering effect crosses or originates inside the field.

The reaction reduces the ally’s damage instead of yours.

Technique Origin

Your Qi techniques may originate from the Cauldron Anchor.

- Range is measured from it.
- You must still perceive or legally sense the target.
- A sealed boundary between you and the Anchor blocks origin unless your Source CL exceeds the seal.
- Weapon-delivered techniques require an actual weapon or Domain Armament at the origin.

Devour the Lesser Art

Once during each of your turns, when a hostile creature in the field activates a Qi effect whose Source CL is at least 6 lower than yours and whose total Qi cost is no more than Proficiency Bonus, you may spend 2 Essences as a Reaction to force it to make a Constitution saving throw.

Failure: The activation fails, its cost remains spent, and gain 1 Essence.  
Success: The activation resolves, but its damage against creatures in the field is reduced by Proficiency Bonus.

This cannot consume Secret, Immortal, artifact, permanent, or strategic effects.

End of the Field

When the field ends normally, you may spend any remaining Essence to prevent its scene-end damage.

- Each Essence spent this way cancels the 1d6 backlash from one Essence.
- Uncancelled Essence resolves normally.
- If you consumed 6 or more total Cultivation Points through the field, gain 1 Corruption when it ends.

tianxia.subpath.qi.heaven_devouring_blac.player_text:
Cultivation Level 3 — Swallow the Residue

You consume the energetic residue of a hostile technique as it reaches you.

Reaction  
You can use this when  A hostile Qi-powered effect deals you one or more valid energy damage types.  
Cost: 1 Qi  
Limit: Once per round

Choose one valid damage type in the triggering packet.

Reduce that damage by:

2d8 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier

If you reduce at least 1 damage, gain 1 Essence matching that damage type.

Swallow the Residue applies after Immunity and before Temporary Hit Points.

It cannot reduce:

- Damage from your own feature.
- Damage voluntarily accepted as a price.
- Permanent sacrifice.
- Lifespan loss.
- Pure conceptual harm with no energy expression.
- Damage an effect says cannot be reduced.

Spit the Principle

Once per turn when you deal damage with a Qi feature, spend 1 Essence to add matching damage:

- 1d8 at Cultivation Level 3.
- 2d8 at Cultivation Level 11.
- 3d8 at Cultivation Level 17.

Apply this once to the activation, not once per projectile, target, attack, or damage packet.

When used with a weapon-delivered technique, apply it to either the weapon damage or technique damage.

Consecrated Energy

Radiant or consecrated energy can be swallowed only when your Source CL equals or exceeds the effect’s Source CL. Otherwise, the reaction still reduces damage, but you gain no Essence.

---

tianxia.subpath.qi.heaven_splitting_conc.player_text:
Cultivation Level 14 — Divide Heaven and Earth

Action  
Range: 90 feet  
Area: A plane up to 60 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick  
Duration: 1 minute  
Concentration: Required  
Cost: 6 Qi

Create a visible or invisible conceptual division.

Choose one relation that cannot cross the division.

Division of Passage

Creatures and objects cannot physically cross.

A creature attempting to cross makes a Strength or Charisma saving throw.

- On failure, its movement ends in the nearest legal space.
- On success, it crosses but takes 4d8 Force damage.

Division of Qi

Cultivation techniques, Cultivation Point transfer, Remote Technique Origin, Domain Armament control, and active Qi tethers cannot cross.

A technique whose Source CL equals or exceeds yours may cross after its user succeeds on a Cultivation Check against your save DC.

Division of Sight

Vision, Truesight, visual divination, and line-of-sight targeting cannot cross.

Blindsight, Tremorsense, or another sense crosses only when its physical medium remains connected around the division.

Division of Sound

Sound, audible commands, audible techniques, and sound-based communication cannot cross.

Thunder damage can cross only if its Source Rule does not require sound transmission and its Source CL equals or exceeds yours.

Division of Space

Teleportation, portals, phasing, pocket-space access, summoning, and planar movement cannot cross.

Equal/higher Secret or spatial authority requires a Cultivation Check against your save DC.

Division of Healing

Healing, Temporary Hit Points, condition removal, Cultivation Point restoration, and restorative tethers cannot cross.

Self-healing on either side remains functional.

Division of Command

Companion commands, Formation control, Domain Armament commands, possession control, and summoned-asset orders cannot cross.

Assets retain their last legal instruction or default behavior.

Division of Cause and Effect

A hostile or beneficial effect originating on one side cannot affect a target on the other side, even when its physical projectile or visual manifestation crosses.

This is the most demanding form.

- Increase its Qi cost by 2.
- A Source CL equal or higher may contest with a Cultivation Check each activation.
- Secret, Karma, Fate, Samsara, and conceptual effects are not automatically blocked; they contest normally.

Move the Division

Once during each of your turns, move or rotate the plane up to 10 feet without using an action.

It cannot pass through a creature. A creature in the new space chooses the nearest legal side.

Severed Crossing

A creature that forcibly crosses after succeeding on a save gains 1 Severance Mark.

---

tianxia.subpath.qi.heaven_splitting_conc.player_text:
Cultivation Level 18 — One Cut Divides Ten Thousand Laws

Action  
Range: 120 feet  
Cost: 8 Qi  
Limit: Once per scene

Choose one creature, object, Cultivation Asset, active manifestation, oath, soul, body, name, or other valid target bearing 3 Severance Marks or intersected by Divide Heaven and Earth.

Make one Cultivation Attack or force a Charisma saving throw, chosen according to whether your expression is a cutting strike or direct law.

On a hit or failed save, choose one Sovereign Severance.

On a miss or successful save, apply its listed lesser result.

Body from Soul

Full Severance:

- The target’s soul, consciousness, or animating spirit is removed from its body and appears as a visible incorporeal form in an adjacent space.
- The body is Incapacitated and Stable.
- The soul cannot reenter without reconnecting the severed relation.
- Possession of another body requires an independent legal feature.

Duration:

- Within 2 CL: until the end of your next turn, followed by repeated Charisma saves at the end of each turn.
- 3–5 CL lower: 1 minute with no automatic repeat.
- At least 6 CL lower: indefinite.

Lesser:

- Incapacitated until the end of the current turn.
- Cannot use Spirit, soul, possession, or body-transfer features until the start of its next turn.

Cultivation from Vessel

Full Severance:

Suppress all:

- Path features.
- Subpath features.
- Spheres and talents.
- Methods.
- Foundations’ active systems.
- Golden Core and Nascent Soul features.
- Domain Armaments.
- Recorded Arts.
- Forged Techniques.
- Immortal Arts.
- Cultivated-item active properties.
- Cultivation Point expenditure and recovery.

The target retains mundane movement, speech, ordinary ability checks, and ordinary equipment use.

Duration uses the same authority bands as Body from Soul.

Lesser:

- Cannot spend Cultivation Points or activate powered techniques until the start of its next turn.

Name from Authority

Full Severance:

Sever one supernatural name, title, office, lineage recognition, command authority, ownership bond, contract identity, artifact recognition, or Domain claim from the target.

Consequences may include:

- Artifacts no longer recognize it.
- Oaths and contracts cannot identify it as holder or beneficiary.
- Commanded assets no longer accept orders.
- A lineage inheritance becomes inaccessible.
- A titled Domain or Formation no longer recognizes its authority.
- Divination using the severed name fails.

This does not erase the target’s memories or ordinary social recognition unless the severed name was the actual conceptual basis of those effects.

Lesser:

- One named item, asset, contract, or authority refuses the target until the start of its next turn.

Technique from Source

Full Severance:

Choose one learned Sphere, Subpath, Method, Recorded Art family, Forged Technique, Secret feature, or cultivation system.

The target retains memory of it but cannot connect to its active use.

Duration uses the authority bands above.

Against a target at least 6 CL lower, this may be indefinite.

A Secret or Immortal feature requires a successful Cultivation Check against its save DC after the failed save.

Lesser:

- The chosen system is suppressed until the start of its next turn.

Cause from Effect

Full Severance:

Choose one category:

- Damage.
- Healing.
- Forced movement.
- Conditions.
- Summoning.
- Teleportation.
- Cultivation Point restoration.
- Command.
- Possession.

For the duration, actions and techniques used by the target cannot produce that category of effect.

Costs are still spent on attempted activations unless the inability was obvious before activation.

Lesser:

- The target’s next activation in that category fails to produce the chosen effect.

Target from World

Full Severance:

The target is cut away from ordinary space and exists in an adjacent conceptual interval.

While severed:

- It cannot affect or be affected by ordinary reality.
- It perceives the outside world as distant outlines.
- Its durations continue.
- It does not regain Cultivation Points.
- It may use an Action to make a Cultivation Check against your save DC when its Source CL is within 2 of yours or higher.

Duration:

- Within 2 CL: until the end of your next turn, with checks each turn.
- 3–5 CL lower: 1 minute.
- At least 6 CL lower: indefinite.

This differs from Void erasure: the target and world both remain, but their relation is cut.

Lesser:

- The target is removed until the start of its next turn.

Wound from Victim

Choose a willing creature or yourself.

Full Severance:

Remove one:

- Condition.
- Curse.
- Poison.
- Disease.
- Maximum-Hit-Point reduction.
- Cultivation seal.
- Possession.
- Contract consequence.
- Karmic burden.
- Hidden Injury.
- Permanent transformation.

The removed effect becomes a separate Severed Burden Anchor in an adjacent unoccupied space.

Severed Burden Anchor

- AC: 18
- Hit Points: 6 × your Qi Cultivation CL
- Resistance: All damage except Force, Psychic, and Void
- Immunity: Poison and Psychic damage
- Source CL: The greater of yours or the removed effect’s Source CL

Destroying the Anchor destroys the burden when your Source CL equals or exceeds it.

If the Anchor survives for 1 minute:

- The burden remains separated but not destroyed.
- It can be sealed, transferred, studied, or reattached by appropriate authority.

An effect whose Source CL exceeds yours requires a Cultivation Check against its save DC.

Lesser:

- Suppress the burden until the start of your next turn.

Reconnecting a Sovereign Severance

An indefinite Sovereign Severance can be repaired by:

- Equal/higher Conceptual Severance or conceptual restoration.
- Samsara return to a state before the cut.
- Karma or Fate authority proving and restoring the relationship.
- Name authority restoring a severed identity or ownership.
- Void authority erasing the cut itself without erasing the target.
- Reconstruction through the original complete cultivation source and a major breakthrough.
- An artifact, Immortal, ancestor, heavenly authority, or equivalent source.
- Acceptance of a permanent substitute relation or price established through play.

Ordinary healing, rest, retraining, or reacquiring proficiency does not repair an indefinite conceptual cut.
