tianxia.subpath.body.thousand_eyed_calam.player_text:
Cultivation Level 3 - Calamity Appraisal

At the start of your turn, choose one creature within 60 feet as Appraised until the start of your next turn.

Learn its AC, whether Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution is highest and lowest, and whether it is above or below half maximum Hit Points.

Once per turn on a hit against it, deal additional damage equal to Proficiency Bonus.

Normalized Procedure — Calamity Appraisal Record

- At the start of your turn after choosing Open Eyes, select one creature you can perceive within 60 feet. It becomes Appraised until the start of your next turn.
- Record identity, Source CL, known AC, highest and lowest among Strength/Dexterity/Constitution, half-Hit-Point band, and expiration.
- If two or more physical abilities tie for highest or lowest, learn every tied ability. You learn only whether current Hit Points are above or below half maximum, not exact Hit Points or maximum.
- Appraisal reads current observable combat structure. A higher-authority disguise, false body, Secret concealment, or anti-divination effect can produce a contest or block the information under its own rules.
- The additional damage equal to Proficiency Bonus applies once per turn on one hit against the currently Appraised target and uses the triggering attack's damage type unless you choose Force. It is part of that hit and cannot critically multiply separately.

tianxia.subpath.body.thousand_eyed_calam.player_text:
Cultivation Level 6 - Eye beneath the Skin

Reaction  
You can use this when  A creature you can see makes an attack roll against you.  
Cost: 1 Stamina  
Limit: Once per round

Add Proficiency Bonus to AC against that attack.

If it misses, the attacker becomes Appraised until the end of your next turn, you move 5 feet without provoking, and it cannot gain Advantage against you merely by becoming unseen before your next turn.

Normalized Procedure — Eye beneath the Skin

- Declare after a visible creature makes an attack roll against you but before the roll's success is announced. Spend the Reaction and 1 Stamina, then add Proficiency Bonus to AC against that attack only.
- If the modified attack misses, resolve the printed benefits after the miss: Appraise the attacker until the end of your next turn, move up to 5 feet without provoking, and deny unseen-only Advantage until before your next turn ends.
- The movement is physical and follows legal-space rules. It cannot change whether the already resolved attack hit.
- If the attack still hits, none of the miss benefits occur. The Reaction and Stamina remain spent.
- The temporary Appraisal can coexist with the start-of-turn Appraisal at Cultivation Level 18 only when the feature's maintained-target limit permits it; before Cultivation Level 18, it replaces the prior Appraised target for overlapping duration unless the source explicitly permits more.

tianxia.subpath.body.thousand_eyed_calam.player_text:
Cultivation Level 14 - Hundred Eyes Open

While at least 4 Eyes are open:

- Blindsight 40 feet.
- See in every direction and cannot be flanked.
- Automatically notice visible creatures entering your reach.
- Advantage against illusions and gaze effects.
- Know when a visible creature begins casting, invoking, or circulating a technique, though not necessarily its identity.

Reaction  
You can use this when  Your Appraised Target moves, teleports, attacks, or activates a technique within 60 feet.  
Cost: 1 Stamina  
Limit: Once per round

Choose one:

- Move 15 feet without provoking.
- Make one unarmed strike if within reach.
- Impose Disadvantage on one attack roll it makes.
- Add Proficiency Bonus to one save you make against the triggering feature.

The attack follows the Granted Attack rule.

Normalized Procedure — Hundred Eyes Open

- The passive benefits function while at least 4 Eyes remain open. Closing below 4 makes them dormant immediately.
- Seeing in every direction prevents flanking benefits that rely only on facing or an unwatched side. It does not see through total cover or negate concealment beyond your senses.
- Automatically noticing a visible creature entering reach reveals that entry; it does not grant an Opportunity Attack or interrupt unless another rule supplies one.
- You know that a visible creature has begun casting, invoking, or circulating a technique when its activation becomes observable. You do not automatically learn the technique's name, target, cost, hidden mode, or result.
- The Reaction trigger occurs when the Appraised target commits movement, teleportation, an attack, or a technique activation within 60 feet. Choose one response and spend 1 Stamina.
- Movement occurs immediately after the trigger commits and before later effects when legally possible. A granted unarmed strike occurs before the triggering movement finishes or attack resolves if the target is currently within reach; it follows Granted Attack rules and does not automatically cancel the trigger.
- Imposing Disadvantage affects one attack roll from the triggering activation, chosen before that roll. Adding Proficiency Bonus affects one save you make against the triggering feature, chosen before that save is resolved.
- A trigger without an attack roll or save can still be answered by movement or the granted strike.

tianxia.subpath.body.thousand_eyed_calam.player_text:
Cultivation Level 10 - Read the Killing Line

Once per turn when targeting an Appraised creature, spend 1 Stamina and choose one:

- Unclouded Line: Ignore Disadvantage, Half Cover, and Three-Quarters Cover on one attack roll.
- Piercing Appraisal: On a hit, additional 2d8 damage.
- Exposed Meridian: When a Body Refining feature forces its identified lowest physical save, subtract 1d4 from that save.
- Denied Escape: On a hit, no Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- Read Resistance: The triggering attack ignores one Resistance revealed by the Appraisal; not Immunity.

Normalized Procedure — Read the Killing Line

- Use once per turn while targeting an Appraised creature. Spend 1 Stamina and choose exactly one mode at the mode's required timing.
- Unclouded Line: Declare before one attack roll. Remove Disadvantage from that roll and ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover. Total cover, blocked line of effect, and an illegal target remain.
- Piercing Appraisal: Declare after a hit. Add 2d8 damage to that hit using one of the hit's damage types or Force.
- Exposed Meridian: Declare when one of your Body Refining features forces the physical save identified as the target's lowest. Subtract 1d4 from that save result after the roll. If several abilities tied for lowest, any tied save qualifies.
- Denied Escape: Declare after a hit. The target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; this does not cancel a Reaction already resolved.
- Read Resistance: Declare on an attack before damage is applied. Ignore one ordinary Resistance you actually learned through Appraisal or another explicit information source. This never ignores Immunity or an unconfirmed guessed Resistance.
- One use cannot combine modes. A miss after choosing an attack-dependent mode spends the Stamina and use unless the mode expressly declared on hit.

tianxia.subpath.body.thousand_eyed_calam.player_text:
Cultivation Level 18 - Thousand-Eyed Revelation

Bonus Action  
Duration: 1 minute  
Cost: 7 Stamina  
Limit: Once per scene

All Eyes open.

For the duration:

- Truesight 120 feet and Blindsight 60 feet.
- Cannot be Surprised.
- Attack rolls against you cannot gain Advantage.
- Maintain Appraised Targets equal to Proficiency Bonus.
- Learn exact Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution save bonuses.
- Once per turn on a hit against an Appraised Target, additional 4d8 Psychic or Force.
- Read the Killing Line costs 0 Stamina once per turn.

Calamity Gaze

Action  
Area: 60-foot cone  
Cost: 3 Stamina  
Saving Throw: Wisdom

- Failed Save: 8d8 Psychic, Appraised for the duration, cannot become Invisible to you, and no Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- Successful Save: Half damage and Appraised until the start of your next turn.

A creature is affected once per use.

Normalized Procedure — Thousand-Eyed Revelation

- Activation opens every Eye to your current maximum and overrides the ordinary start-of-turn choice for the duration. Suppression can lower the effective maximum and closes excess Eyes first.
- Truesight 120 feet and Blindsight 60 feet replace lower ranges. “Attack rolls cannot gain Advantage” removes every Advantage source from attacks against you; Disadvantage still applies normally and can make the roll disadvantaged.
- Maintain Appraised targets up to Proficiency Bonus. Each record uses the normal Appraisal data plus exact Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution save bonuses. When exceeding the limit, choose a record to end.
- The once-per-turn 4d8 Psychic or Force rider applies to one hit against any Appraised target and replaces no other Appraisal rider.
- Read the Killing Line costs 0 Stamina for one use each turn. Additional legal uses, if another rule grants them, pay normal cost.
- Calamity Gaze: The cone originates from you and requires line of effect. Each creature is affected once per use. On failure it takes 8d8 Psychic, becomes Appraised for the transformation's remaining duration, cannot become Invisible to you, and loses Reactions until the start of its next turn. On success it takes half and is Appraised only until the start of your next turn.
- “Cannot become Invisible to you” means Invisibility does not make that creature invisible to your senses; it does not dispel Invisibility for other observers. A superior Source CL concealment can contest this authority under its own rule.

tianxia.subpath.body.thousand_fold_steel.player_text:
Cultivation Level 6 - Quench the Impact

Reaction  
You can use this when  You take qualifying hostile damage.  
Cost: 1 Stamina  
Limit: Once per round

Change your active form immediately and apply its Quench benefit:

- Edge Quench: Your next melee attack before the end of your next turn deals an additional 2d8 Slashing or Force damage.
- Spine Quench: Reduce triggering damage by 2d8 + Constitution modifier.
- Reed Quench: After damage resolves, move 15 feet without provoking.

The selected form remains until the start of your next turn.

Normalized Procedure — Quench the Impact

- Declare when qualifying hostile damage would be applied to you, after percentage modifiers are known but before Hit Points are reduced. Spend the Reaction and 1 Stamina, choose one Form, and make it active immediately until the start of your next turn.
- At Cultivation Level 3–13, the selected Form replaces the current active Form. At Cultivation Level 14+, use the feature's two-Form replacement rule. Selecting a Form already active is legal and still grants its Quench benefit.
- Edge Quench: After the triggering damage resolves, record one charge. Your next melee attack before the end of your next turn adds 2d8 Slashing or Force to its damage on a hit. A new Edge Quench refreshes rather than stacks with an unused charge.
- Spine Quench: Reduce the triggering packet by 2d8 + Constitution modifier at the shared damage-reduction step. This is separate from Spine Form's first-packet reduction and can apply to the same packet if both are available.
- Reed Quench: After the triggering damage resolves, move up to 15 feet without provoking along a legal route. The movement occurs even if final damage became 0, but not if the damage event was canceled before it existed.
- Changing Forms is prospective. It does not retroactively alter the triggering attack roll, percentage modifiers, damage type, or another event already resolved.

tianxia.subpath.body.thousand_fold_steel.player_text:
Cultivation Level 14 - Ten Thousand Reforgings

Maintain two different Tempering Forms simultaneously. When using Quench the Impact, replace one or both active forms but apply only one Quench benefit.

Improvements:

- Edge additional damage becomes twice Proficiency Bonus.
- Spine damage reduction becomes twice Proficiency Bonus.
- Reed movement becomes 10 feet.

Normalized Procedure — Ten Thousand Reforgings

- Choose two different active Forms at the start of each turn. Each Form keeps its own limit and benefit.
- When you use Quench the Impact, choose one Quench benefit. You may replace one active Form with another, replace both active Forms with the other two-Form combination, or retain the current pair. Forms must remain different.
- Applying one Quench benefit does not apply the benefit of the second newly selected Form. Its normal Form benefit becomes active prospectively.
- Edge Form's once-per-turn damage becomes twice Proficiency Bonus. Spine Form's first-packet reduction becomes twice Proficiency Bonus. Reed Form's once-per-turn movement becomes 10 feet. These replace, rather than add to, their earlier numerical values.
- If effective CL suppression removes this feature, retain one legal active Form chosen by you and make the second dormant until access returns or the next start-of-turn choice.

tianxia.subpath.body.vermilion_gate_guar.player_text:
Cultivation Level 3 - Guardian at the Gate

Reaction  
You can use this when  A hostile creature crosses your Guarded Threshold.

Make one unarmed strike or melee weapon attack against it before it completes the crossing.

On a hit, its movement ends in the nearest legal space before the threshold, its Speed becomes 0 until the end of the turn, and it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

A creature can trigger this only once during the same movement. The attack follows the Granted Attack rule.

Normalized Procedure — Guardian at the Gate

- Trigger immediately before an ordinary or forced movement segment would complete a crossing. Teleportation, phasing, appearing, or a threshold being placed across a stationary creature does not trigger this Reaction.
- Make exactly one unarmed strike or melee weapon attack against the crossing creature. The attack follows the Granted Attack rule.
- On a miss, the crossing continues. On a hit, finish the attack and its damage, then place the creature in the nearest legal space on the side from which it attempted to cross. End that movement, set every Speed to 0 until the end of the current turn, and deny Reactions.
- If several spaces are equally near, you choose one that does not place the creature across the threshold. If no legal space exists, use Failed Spatial Movement with the status quo on the originating side.
- One creature can trigger Guardian at the Gate only once during one continuous movement, even if its space intersects the threshold repeatedly. A later separate movement can trigger again if you have a Reaction.

tianxia.subpath.body.vermilion_gate_guar.player_text:
Cultivation Level 18 - Heaven's Closed Gate

Action  
Area: 30-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder centered on you  
Duration: 1 minute  
Cost: 7 Stamina  
Limit: Once per scene

A vast threshold manifests around the boundary. You and chosen allies cross freely.

A hostile creature attempting to cross makes a Strength or Charisma saving throw, its choice.

- Failed Save: Movement ends at the boundary, Speed becomes 0 for the turn, it takes 4d8 Force damage, and cannot attempt to cross again that turn.
- Successful Save: It crosses, but the boundary is Difficult Terrain for that movement.

A hostile teleport or phase attempt instead uses the Cultivation Check and Failed Spatial Movement rules.

Ranged attacks and effects crossing the boundary grant Three-Quarters Cover to targets inside.

Four visible anchor posts appear at cardinal points. Each has AC equal to your Cultivation Save DC, Hit Points 3 x CL, Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, and Force, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic. Destroying two reduces protection to Half Cover; destroying all four ends the Gate.

You may maintain only one Heaven's Closed Gate.

---

Normalized Procedure — Heaven's Closed Gate

- When activated, choose the point at the center of your current space. The cylinder and anchor posts are stationary at that point for the duration; they do not move when you move.
- Choose any number of willing allies you can perceive when activating the Gate. You and those allies cross freely. A creature not chosen is treated according to its current hostility and the feature's normal crossing procedure.
- The boundary is the cylinder's vertical outer surface and top. A hostile creature crosses when ordinary movement would take any part of its space from outside to inside or inside to outside through that surface.
- On a failed Strength or Charisma save, place the creature in the nearest legal space on the side where the attempt began, deal 4d8 Force damage, set Speed to 0 for the turn, and prevent another crossing attempt that turn. On success, it crosses; movement through the boundary costs double as Difficult Terrain for that crossing.
- Hostile teleportation, phasing, and other spatial movement across the boundary use one Cultivation Check and Failed Spatial Movement instead of the Strength or Charisma save.
- Three-Quarters Cover applies only to a target inside when an attack or cover-sensitive effect originates outside and crosses the boundary. Destroying two posts changes this to Half Cover. Destroying all four ends the complete Gate, including crossing restrictions and spatial checks.
- The four posts are visible projected Body Anchors at the cardinal boundary points. Each is a discrete Medium object that does not occupy its space, can attach to ground or a solid surface, and has the printed AC, Hit Points, Resistances, and Immunities. They cannot act, move, attack, or be harvested.
- A post reduced to 0 Hit Points is destroyed. Excess damage does not transfer to you or another post. Healing a post requires a feature that can repair Body Assets or cultivation Anchors and cannot restore a destroyed post during the same activation unless expressly permitted.
- If terrain makes an exact cardinal point impossible, place the post at the nearest point on the boundary with line of effect to the center. This does not change the cylinder's area.
- You may maintain only one Heaven's Closed Gate. A new activation ends the previous one without refunding costs.

---

tianxia.subpath.body.vermilion_gate_guar.player_text:
Cultivation Level 6 - Shelter Behind the Gate

Allies you choose within 5 feet of your threshold gain +1 AC against ranged attacks originating from the opposite side, Advantage against being pushed or pulled across it, and may stand from Prone by spending 5 feet of movement.

Reaction  
You can use this when  A willing ally within 10 feet of the threshold is moved against its will.  
Cost: 1 Stamina  
Limit: Once per round

Reduce the forced movement by 15 feet. If reduced to 0, the ally is not knocked Prone by the same effect and is moved to the nearest unoccupied space adjacent to the threshold.

Normalized Procedure — Shelter Behind the Gate

- Determine “within 5 feet” from the nearest point of the threshold line. Choose allies when each benefit would apply; no action or permanent designation is required.
- A ranged attack originates from the opposite side when the attacker's origin and the target's space are on different sides and the attack line crosses the threshold. The +1 AC applies only against that attack and does not stack from two thresholds.
- Advantage applies to checks and saves directly resisting a push or pull that would cross the threshold. It does not affect teleportation, phasing, or forced movement remaining on the same side.
- Standing from Prone for 5 feet of movement still requires the ally to have at least 5 feet of movement available and be physically capable of standing.
- For the Reaction, the willing ally must be within 10 feet of at least one threshold when the forced movement is declared. Reduce the complete forced movement distance by 15 feet before placement.
- If reduced to 0, cancel only a Prone rider caused by that same movement and place the ally in the nearest unoccupied legal space adjacent to the chosen threshold on either side. If several are equally near, the ally chooses.

tianxia.subpath.body.vermilion_gate_guar.player_text:
Cultivation Level 10 - Twin Guardian Posts

You may maintain two Guarded Thresholds simultaneously. Each must have at least one point within 15 feet of you when placed.

When Guardian at the Gate hits, choose one additional result:

- Push the creature 10 feet away from the threshold.
- Knock it Prone.
- Deal an additional 2d8 Force damage.
- Mark it until the start of your next turn; it has Disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you.

You still have only your normal number of Reactions.

Normalized Procedure — Twin Guardian Posts

- At the start of your turn, place up to two thresholds. Each is a separate line and must have at least one point within 15 feet of you when placed. Both expire at the start of your next turn.
- The lines may intersect, share an endpoint, or overlap, but overlapping sections do not multiply Difficult Terrain, AC, cover, saves, or trigger frequency.
- A crossing that intersects both thresholds can trigger Guardian at the Gate only once from that movement because you still resolve one Reaction and one attack.
- After Guardian at the Gate hits, choose exactly one additional result. Force damage is part of the attack packet. The push is away from the crossed threshold's plane along a legal route. The mark refreshes rather than stacks and affects attack rolls only.
- This feature grants no additional Reaction. An extra Reaction from another rule does not remove Guardian at the Gate's one-trigger-per-continuous-movement rule.

tianxia.subpath.body.white_elephant_sove.player_text:
Cultivation Level 14 - Mountain-Walking Sovereign

As a Bonus Action, become Large or return to normal size, lasting until changed.

While Large:

- Unarmed reach +5 feet.
- Count as two additional sizes larger for carrying, lifting, Grappling, Shoving, and resisting forced movement.
- Speed reduced by 5 feet.
- Ignore ordinary Difficult Terrain.
- Once per turn after moving 10 feet, automatically push one adjacent creature 5 feet unless it is more than two sizes larger.

Normalized Procedure — Mountain-Walking Sovereign

- The Bonus Action changes actual size to Large or returns you to normal size. The transformation lasts until changed, Unconscious, complete Body suppression, or another Source Rule replaces your form.
- Use the Shared Transformation procedure for occupied space, equipment, Squeezing, and legal placement. If no Large space exists, the transformation fails without changing size but still spends the Bonus Action.
- While Large, the “two additional sizes larger” permission applies to the listed carrying, lifting, Grappling, Shoving, and forced-movement operations. It replaces Sovereign Frame's one-category functional-size benefit rather than adding a third additional category.
- The 5-foot Speed reduction and ordinary-difficult-terrain immunity apply while Large. Supernatural, hazardous, creature-created, and Source-CL-governed terrain remains unless expressly ordinary.
- Once per turn after you have willingly moved at least 10 feet, choose one adjacent creature. If it is not more than two actual size categories larger, push it 5 feet without a save. This is one movement event and does not deal collision damage unless another rule prints it.

tianxia.subpath.body.white_elephant_sove.player_text:
Cultivation Level 6 - Shelter Beneath the Tusks

Reaction  
You can use this when  A creature within 15 feet is hit by an attack.  
Cost: 1 Stamina  
Limit: Once per round

Move 10 feet toward it without provoking. If you end adjacent, choose one:

- Become the target instead.
- Grant it Half Cover against the attack.
- Reduce its damage by 2d10 + Constitution modifier.

If you become the target, compare the attack roll to your AC. If the attack cannot legally target you, choose another option.

Normalized Procedure — Shelter Beneath the Tusks

- Declare after the attack hits the protected creature but before damage is rolled or applied. Spend the Reaction and 1 Stamina, then move up to 10 feet toward it without provoking.
- The movement is physical and must end in a legal space adjacent to the protected creature to choose an option. If no such space is reachable, the feature ends after movement and the attack resolves normally.
- Become the Target: The attacker must be able to target you from its original position with the same attack. Replace the target and compare the existing attack roll to your AC; do not reroll. Effects requiring the original target's unique anatomy, bond, mark, or identity cannot be redirected.
- Half Cover: Apply Half Cover retroactively against the triggering attack. Recompare the same roll to the protected creature's modified AC. If the attack now misses, it deals no hit damage.
- Reduce Damage: The attack remains a hit. Reduce its damage by 2d10 + Constitution modifier at the shared flat-reduction step after its percentage modifiers. This protects one target and one triggering attack packet.
- If the first option is illegal, choose either other option; illegality does not refund the Reaction or Stamina after movement has begun.

tianxia.subpath.body.white_elephant_sove.player_text:
Cultivation Level 3 - Sovereign Frame

Count as one size larger for carrying, dragging, lifting, pushing, Grappling, Shoving, and determining whether another creature can move you.

Gain Advantage on saves against being pushed, pulled, knocked Prone, or moved against your will.

Ivory Charge

Once per turn after moving at least 15 feet directly toward a creature before hitting with an unarmed strike, deal additional Bludgeoning or Force damage equal to Proficiency Bonus.

The target makes a Strength save. On a failure, push 10 feet; on a success, 5 feet.

Normalized Procedure — Sovereign Frame and Ivory Charge

- Sovereign Frame grants functional size one category larger only for carrying, dragging, lifting, pushing, Grappling, Shoving, and determining whether another creature can move you. It does not change occupied space, reach, weapon damage, equipment size, or actual creature size.
- Advantage applies to checks and saves made to resist push, pull, Prone, or unwilling movement. It does not automatically prevent teleportation unless that effect is adjudicated as moving you and permits such a save.
- Ivory Charge tracks voluntary movement during the current turn. You must move at least 15 feet along a route that continuously decreases the distance to the target before the qualifying unarmed-strike hit.
- The extra damage applies once per turn and is part of the hit. Choose Bludgeoning or Force on the hit.
- The target makes the Strength save after damage. On failure push 10 feet; on success push 5 feet. The push is directly away from you and follows legal-placement and collision procedures. A target immune to forced movement still takes the extra damage.

tianxia.subpath.body.white_elephant_sove.player_text:
Cultivation Level 10 - The Body Remembers

When a hostile creature damages you, mark it as Remembered until scene end. Maintain a number equal to Proficiency Bonus; exceeding the limit requires forgetting one.

Against a Remembered creature:

- Know its direction within 120 feet.
- It cannot gain Advantage against you merely by being unseen.
- Once per turn on a hit, deal an additional 2d8 Bludgeoning or Force.
- Add Proficiency Bonus to checks and saves against being moved, Grappled, Frightened, or Restrained by it.

Normalized Procedure — Remembered Creature Records

- After a hostile creature deals at least 1 damage to your Hit Points, record it as Remembered until scene end. Record identity, Source CL, last known direction, and acquisition event.
- Maintain up to Proficiency Bonus distinct creatures. When exceeding the limit, choose one existing record to forget or decline the new record.
- Direction sense functions within 120 feet and does not reveal exact distance, route, current condition, disguise, plane, or identity of an unknown creature.
- A Remembered creature cannot gain Advantage against you merely because it is unseen. Other sources of Advantage still apply, and you can still have Disadvantage from inability to see it.
- The additional 2d8 applies once per turn on one hit against any Remembered creature. Choose Bludgeoning or Force on the hit.
- Add Proficiency Bonus only to checks and saves against being moved, Grappled, Frightened, or Restrained by that Remembered creature or its active effect.

tianxia.subpath.body.white_heron_crescen.player_text:
Cultivation Level 3 - Crescent-Body Integration

Gain proficiency with Polearm weapons.

While wielding one:

- Use Constitution instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls.
- You may use your Cultivation Attack Modifier for attack rolls.
- It is integrated into Body Refining.
- Its reach increases by 5 feet during your turn.
- Refined Iron Fist and Heavenly Fist apply to it.

This does not grant a weapon Sphere.

Heron's Passing Cut

You can use this when  You hit with a Polearm after moving at least 10 feet during the turn.  
Cost: 1 Stamina  
Limit: Once per turn

Choose one:

- Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Push the target 10 feet.
- Pull it 5 feet into an unoccupied space within reach.
- Deal an additional 1d8 Slashing or Force damage, increasing to 2d8 at Cultivation Level 11 and 3d8 at Cultivation Level 17.

Normalized Procedure — Crescent-Body Integration and Heron's Passing Cut

- Record the wielded Polearm as an integrated weapon. Constitution replaces Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls, and you may use your Cultivation Attack Modifier for its attack rolls. This integration grants no Sphere, talent, ammunition, additional attack, or separate weapon instance.
- Refined Iron Fist and Heavenly Fist apply only to the extent those features expressly modify an integrated weapon. If several rules replace the same weapon damage die, use the highest legal replacement rather than adding several weapon dice.
- The 5-foot reach increase applies only during your own turn. Outside your turn, use the Polearm's printed reach plus any currently active persistent reach increase. At Cultivation Level 14, the two turn-only increases combine for +10 feet during your turn.
- Heron's Passing Cut checks actual voluntary movement completed during the current turn before the hit. Teleportation does not count. Forced movement counts only when you willingly directed or accepted it and the movement rule says it counts as your movement.
- Declare Heron's Passing Cut after the hit is confirmed, pay 1 Stamina, and choose exactly one result. The feature remains once per turn across all Polearm attacks.
- The 10-foot self-movement is voluntary granted movement, follows a legal route, and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. The push moves directly away from you. The pull must end in an unoccupied space within your current Polearm reach and cannot pull the target through a solid obstruction.
- The additional damage is part of the triggering hit's damage packet, uses Slashing or Force as chosen when applied, and uses only the scaling appropriate to your current CL.

tianxia.subpath.body.white_heron_crescen.player_text:
Cultivation Level 10 - Crescent Reaping Circle

When you take the Attack action with a Polearm, replace one attack with a sweeping cut.

Area: Every hostile creature of your choice within your weapon's reach  
Cost: 2 Stamina  
Limit: Once per turn  
Saving Throw: Dexterity

On a failed save, a target takes one weapon damage die + Constitution modifier + 3d8 Slashing or Force damage, and you either push it 5 feet or prevent Reactions until the start of its next turn.

On a successful save, it takes half damage and suffers no additional effect.

After the sweep, move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

This is not a weapon attack and does not apply attack-hit riders.

Normalized Procedure — Crescent Reaping Circle

- Replace one attack of the Attack action before making that attack. The sweep is one Body technique, not a weapon attack, and affects each chosen hostile creature within your current Polearm reach at the moment the sweep resolves.
- Each target makes one Dexterity save and is affected once even if it occupies several spaces. Cover and line of effect are checked from you through the Polearm's physical sweep.
- The damage uses one damage die of the integrated Polearm, adds Constitution modifier once, and adds 3d8 Slashing or Force as chosen for that activation. It does not apply critical hits, attack-hit riders, weapon mastery riders, or effects requiring a weapon attack to hit.
- On a failed save, choose push or Reaction denial separately for each target. A push is 5 feet directly away from you and stops at the nearest legal space. On a successful save, the target takes half total damage and no rider.
- Resolve all saves, damage, and forced movement before taking the printed 10-foot self-movement. That movement is voluntary granted movement, follows a legal route, and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- The sweep remains once per turn even if another feature grants additional Attack actions or replacement attacks.

tianxia.subpath.body.white_heron_crescen.player_text:
Cultivation Level 18 - Moon over the Reed Sea

Action  
Movement: Up to twice your Speed  
Cost: 7 Stamina  
Limit: Once per scene

Move without provoking Opportunity Attacks. You may cross liquids and vertical surfaces and move through hostile spaces as Difficult Terrain, but not through solid barriers, total cover, or spaces too small for you.

Choose any number of hostile creatures that come within Polearm reach. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw and can be affected only once.

- Failed Save: 10d8 Slashing or Force damage, pushed up to 15 feet, and no Reactions until the end of its next turn.
- Successful Save: Half damage, pushed 5 feet, and no Reactions until the start of its next turn.

When movement ends, enter a guarded stance until the start of your next turn: +2 AC, reach increased by 5 feet, and the first hostile creature entering your reach provokes one Opportunity Attack that does not consume your Reaction. This strike can occur only once and follows the Granted Attack rule.

Normalized Procedure — Moon over the Reed Sea

- Choose a continuous route no longer than twice your current Speed. This is voluntary movement, not teleportation. It ignores Opportunity Attacks and permits movement across liquids, vertical surfaces, and hostile spaces as printed, but still requires line of travel and sufficient space for your body.
- Moving across a liquid or vertical surface does not grant lasting flight. If the movement ends unsupported, resolve falling after the feature finishes unless another rule supports you.
- A hostile creature becomes eligible the first time during this activation any part of its space comes within your current Polearm reach. It can be affected only once. A surviving solid barrier or total cover blocks the physical sweep beyond it.
- Resolve a target's save when it first becomes eligible. On a failure, choose Slashing or Force damage for that target, then choose a legal push distance up to 15 feet directly away from your position at that moment. On success, push exactly 5 feet if a legal space exists.
- Reaction denial applies for the printed duration regardless of whether the push is shortened or prevented. Forced movement cannot place a target in an illegal space.
- After all movement and target resolutions, enter the guarded stance. Its +2 AC and +5-foot reach are persistent until the start of your next turn and therefore enlarge your threatened space during that interval.
- The stance's reaction-free Opportunity Attack can occur once. It triggers only when a hostile creature physically enters that reach after the stance begins; expanding your reach around a stationary creature does not count as entry. The attack follows the Granted Attack rule and cannot generate another attack.

---

tianxia.subpath.body.white_heron_crescen.player_text:
Cultivation Level 6 - One-Legged Guard

Reaction  
You can use this when  A creature within your weapon's reach makes a melee attack against you or a creature adjacent to you.  
Cost: 1 Stamina  
Limit: Once per round

Make one Polearm attack before its attack resolves.

On a hit, choose one:

- Subtract your Proficiency Bonus from the triggering attack roll.
- Move the protected creature 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Push the attacker 5 feet.
- Prevent the attacker from taking Reactions until the start of its next turn.

If moved outside its reach, the triggering attack misses. The granted attack follows the Granted Attack rule.

Normalized Procedure — One-Legged Guard

- Declare after the attacker chooses its target and commits to the melee attack but before the triggering attack roll. Spend the Reaction and Stamina, then resolve the granted Polearm attack first.
- “Within your weapon's reach” uses the reach that applies outside your turn. Turn-only reach increases do not apply. A persistent reach increase, such as the guarded stance from Moon over the Reed Sea, does apply.
- If your Polearm attack misses, the triggering attack resolves unchanged. On a hit, choose exactly one printed result before the triggering attack roll.
- Subtracting Proficiency Bonus modifies the triggering attack roll only. It does not reduce damage or affect later attacks.
- Moving the protected creature requires a legal 5-foot destination. A conscious unwilling creature can decline that movement; if it declines, choose another result. The movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- Pushing the attacker is forced movement directly away from you. After either movement result, recheck the triggering attack's reach and legal target. If its target is no longer within reach, the triggering attack misses without an attack roll.
- Reaction denial begins after your Polearm attack hits and lasts until the start of the attacker's next turn. It does not cancel a Reaction already spent before this feature resolved.
- The granted attack cannot grant another attack and remains subject to the once-per-round limit.

tianxia.subpath.body.white_heron_crescen.player_text:
Cultivation Level 14 - White Wing Crosses the Reed Field

Your Polearm reach increases by another 5 feet during your turn.

Once during each of your turns, after hitting a creature with a Polearm, move through that creature's space as Difficult Terrain without provoking its Opportunity Attacks, up to half your Speed, ending in an unoccupied space.

When you leave its space, choose one:

- Make one Polearm attack against a different creature within reach.
- Push the original creature 10 feet.
- Knock the original creature Prone if it fails a Strength saving throw.
- Gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn.

The additional attack follows the Granted Attack rule.

Normalized Procedure — White Wing Crosses the Reed Field

- The additional 5-foot reach increase is turn-only and combines with Crescent-Body Integration for a total +10 feet during your turn. It does not enlarge threatened space outside your turn.
- Trigger after a Polearm hit once during your turn. The movement occurs after that hit resolves and can pass through the triggering creature's occupied space as Difficult Terrain. It cannot pass through total cover, a solid obstruction, or a space too small for your body.
- Move no more than half your current Speed and end in an unoccupied legal space. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature; other creatures interact with it normally.
- Choose one printed result after reaching the destination. The additional Polearm attack must target a different creature currently within reach and follows the Granted Attack rule.
- The 10-foot push moves the original creature directly away from your final position unless no legal route exists. The Prone option calls for one Strength save after your movement; on a success, the creature remains standing.
- The +2 AC begins after the movement and lasts until the start of your next turn. It is an AC bonus and does not replace your AC formula.
- If you cannot complete at least 5 feet of legal movement through the triggering creature's space, you do not gain a chosen ending result.

tianxia.subpath.body.yamabushi.feature.a.player_text:
Cultivation Level 14 - Ascetic Body

You gain:

- Immunity to mundane disease.
- Immunity to environmental cold.
- No requirement for ordinary food or drink.
- The ability to complete a long rest through 4 hours of meditation while remaining aware of your surroundings.
- Advantage on saving throws against Exhaustion, possession, and forced bodily transformation.

Still as the Peak

At the start of your turn, if you are touching earth, stone, or worked masonry and have not willingly moved since the end of your previous turn, reduce the Stamina cost of the next Body Refining Path or Subpath feature you activate before the end of the turn by 1, to a minimum of 1. This functions once per round.

Normalized Procedure — Ascetic Body
- Mundane disease and environmental cold are distinct from supernatural disease, Cold damage, a curse, a Tribulation, or a cultivation affliction unless its Source Rule classifies it as mundane or environmental.
- Not requiring ordinary food or drink removes normal nutritional upkeep. It does not waive a spirit appetite, Method requirement, Offering, medicine, rare-material cost, or Source Rule that consumes a specific substance.
- The 4-hour meditation completes a Long Rest only if all other Long Rest requirements are met. You remain aware but are still resting and cannot perform strenuous activity, guard through active combat, train, craft, or maintain an incompatible Concentration effect during the meditation.
- Advantage against possession and forced bodily transformation applies to saves and contests resisting entry, control, or alteration. It does not remove an effect already established unless that effect permits a repeated save.
- Still as the Peak. Determine eligibility at the start of your turn. Forced movement since the end of your previous turn does not break the requirement; any voluntary movement does. Touching earth, stone, or worked masonry with any part of your body qualifies. Apply the reduction to the first eligible Body Refining Path or Subpath activation before the end of that turn, then expend the once-per-round benefit even if the feature has multiple costs.

tianxia.subpath.body.yamabushi.feature.a.player_text:
Cultivation Level 18 - Avatar of the Mountain

Bonus Action  
Duration: 1 minute  
Cost: 6 Stamina  
Limit: Once per scene

For the duration:

- Gain Resistance to all damage except Force, Psychic, and Void.
- Gain Tremorsense 30 feet while touching a solid surface.
- Ignore Difficult Terrain.
- Gain Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws.
- Your Speed is reduced by 10 feet.
- An effect whose Source CL is lower than yours cannot push, pull, knock you Prone, or teleport you unwillingly.
- Once per turn when you hit with an unarmed strike or integrated Staff weapon, deal an additional 2d8 Bludgeoning or Force damage.

An equal- or higher-CL effect contests your Cultivation Check when attempting to move or teleport you.

tianxia.subpath.body.yamabushi.feature.m.player_text:
Cultivation Level 10 - Mountain's Wrath

Action  
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you  
Cost: 4 Stamina  
Saving Throw: Dexterity

On a failed save, a creature takes 6d6 Bludgeoning or Force damage and falls Prone. On a successful save, it takes half damage and remains standing.

Unattended objects, structures, temporary barriers, and terrain take double damage. The ground becomes Difficult Terrain until cleared or repaired.

Normalized Procedure — Mountain's Wrath
- The sphere is centered on you and affects each other creature in the area once. You are not a target. Allies are affected unless another feature protects them.
- Choose Bludgeoning or Force when you activate the feature; all damage from that activation uses the chosen type.
- The effect requires line of effect through the ground or surrounding physical medium. It does not pass a complete barrier that blocks the shock unless that barrier is itself destroyed by the same activation and its rule permits simultaneous passage.
- Listed unattended objects and terrain take double damage once. Worn, carried, wielded, piloted, or actively controlled objects are not unattended.
- Ordinary ground in the area becomes Difficult Terrain. It remains until each affected 5-foot square is cleared by 1 minute of ordinary work with suitable tools, repaired by an appropriate cultivation or crafting procedure, or replaced by terrain authority of equal or higher Source CL.
- The terrain alteration is bounded to the 20-foot-radius area and does not create world-scale geological damage beyond the printed damage to discrete targets.

tianxia.subpath.qi.abyssal_depths_cultiv.player_text:
Cultivation Level 14 — Deep’s Embrace

Gain:

- A Swim Speed equal to your walking Speed.
- The ability to breathe air and water.
- Darkvision 60 feet, or increase existing Darkvision by 30 feet.
- The ability to communicate simple concepts with ordinary aquatic animals through sound, movement, pressure, and Qi.
- Advantage on checks to navigate underwater terrain, identify currents, and detect changes in pressure.

Simple aquatic communication does not:

- Compel obedience.
- Grant detailed language.
- Reveal information the animal does not know.
- Replace Beast Taming.

Liquid Body

Bonus Action  
Duration: Until the start of your next turn  
Cost: 3 Qi

Become coherent abyssal water.

For the duration:

- Gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from weapon attacks.
- Move through creature spaces as Difficult Terrain.
- Pass through openings at least 1 inch wide.
- Ordinary physical attempts to Grapple or Restrain you automatically fail when their Source CL is lower than yours.
- Immediately end one ordinary physical Grappled or Restrained condition whose Source CL is lower than yours.
- Against an equal or higher Source CL, gain Advantage on checks and saving throws to escape.
- Move through ordinary water without additional movement cost.
- Do not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures whose spaces you move through.

You cannot:

- End your turn inside another creature.
- End inside a solid object.
- Pass through an airtight or liquid-tight barrier.
- Pass through a Force barrier.
- Pass through a sealed Formation.
- Carry an unwilling creature through an opening it could not normally enter.

If Liquid Body ends in an illegal space:

- Move to the nearest legal space.
- Take 4d10 Force damage.

This damage cannot be reduced by Abyssal Depths features.

Pressure Mantle

While in an Abyssal environment:

- Gain +1 AC.
- Gain Advantage on Concentration saving throws caused by damage.
- Your Domain Armament may deal Cold or Force damage.

tianxia.subpath.qi.abyssal_depths_cultiv.player_text:
Cultivation Level 6 — Flowing Evasion

Reaction  
You can use this when  An attack roll hits you and would deal damage.  
Cost: 2 Qi  
Limit: Once per round

After applying Resistance and Vulnerability, halve the remaining damage from the triggering attack.

Then move:

- 5 feet; or
- 10 feet if fully submerged or inside your Moon’s Pull field.

This movement:

- Does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- May pass through one creature’s space as Difficult Terrain.
- Cannot pass through a solid barrier.
- Cannot pass through a sealed Formation.
- Must end in a legal unoccupied space.

Flowing Evasion affects:

- Melee weapon attacks.
- Ranged weapon attacks.
- Spell attacks.
- Cultivation attacks.
- Domain Armament attacks.
- Other damaging attack rolls.

It does not affect:

- A saving-throw effect.
- An automatic hit.
- Environmental damage.
- Damage without an attack roll.
- A permanent Hit Point maximum reduction.

Slip the Grasp

If the triggering attacker had you Grappled or Restrained through a physical hold, make an immediate Strength or Dexterity saving throw, your choice, against the effect’s save DC.

On a success:

- End that Grappled or Restrained condition before moving.

If no save DC exists, use:

8 + source Proficiency Bonus + source key ability modifier

tianxia.subpath.qi.abyssal_depths_cultiv.player_text:
Cultivation Level 18 — Leviathan’s Womb

Bonus Action  
Duration: 1 minute  
Cost: 8 Qi  
Limit: Once per scene

A colossal leviathan-shaped mantle of abyssal water forms around you.

This is an external Qi avatar.

You retain:

- Your statistics.
- Your equipment.
- Your ability to wield weapons.
- Your ability to use Spheres, Recorded Arts, Forged Techniques, and Domain Armaments.

For the duration:

- Your effective size becomes Large if smaller.
- Gain a Swim Speed of 60 feet.
- Gain a Fly Speed of 30 feet and Hover.
- Gain Immunity to Cold damage.
- Gain Resistance to Fire, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
- Your reach increases by 5 feet.
- You can breathe air and water.
- You ignore nonartifact water pressure, currents, and depth.
- Moon’s Pull does not require Concentration while centered on you or your Abyssal Domain Armament.
- Liquid Body costs 0 Qi once per round.
- Once per turn, one Qi-powered feature or authorized weapon-delivered technique deals an additional 3d8 Cold or Force damage to one target.
- You may originate Water-, Cold-, Gravity-, Moon-, Mist-, or Abyss-tagged techniques from any point inside your occupied space or from your Abyssal Domain Armament.

Crushing Coil

You can use this when  You hit a creature within your reach with one of the following:

- A melee weapon attack.
- A Domain Armament Attack.
- A Qi-powered melee technique.
- A weapon-delivered cultivation technique using a melee weapon.

Cost: 2 Qi  
Limit: Once per turn  
Saving Throw: Strength

The creature must be no more than one size larger than your effective size.

Failed Save

The target becomes Grappled and Restrained by your leviathan mantle.

While it remains restrained:

- Its Speed is 0.
- It cannot willingly teleport.
- It takes 2d8 Cold or Force damage at the start of each of its turns.
- It repeats the Strength saving throw at the end of each turn, ending both conditions on a success.

Successful Save

Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

You may maintain one Crushing Coil.

Applying it to another creature ends the previous Coil.

Crushing Coil ends when:

- Leviathan’s Womb ends.
- You become Unconscious.
- The target moves beyond your reach through an effect that breaks the Coil.
- The target succeeds on its saving throw.
- An effect explicitly severs the binding.

Abyssal Court

A hostile creature makes a Constitution saving throw when it:

- Enters a space within 10 feet of you for the first time during a turn.
- Starts its turn within 10 feet of you.

A creature is affected once per turn.

Failed Save:

- 3d8 Cold or Force damage.
- Pull it 5 feet toward you.
- It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

Successful Save:

- Half damage.
- No pull.
- It retains its Reactions.

Allies you choose within 10 feet:

- Gain Resistance to Cold damage.
- Gain Advantage against forced movement.
- May move through your space as Difficult Terrain.

tianxia.subpath.qi.abyssal_depths_cultiv.player_text:
Cultivation Level 10 — Moon’s Pull

Bonus Action  
Range: 60 feet  
Area: 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder  
Duration: 1 minute  
Concentration: Required  
Cost: 5 Qi

Create a field of lunar tide and abyssal pressure.

You may center the field on:

- A visible point.
- Your Abyssal Domain Armament.

If centered on your Domain Armament:

- The field moves with it.
- It cannot move more than 20 feet during one of your turns while carrying the field.
- If the Armament is suppressed, the field remains at its last legal point until suppression ends or the duration expires.

Failed Save

- Pull it up to 15 feet toward the field’s center.
- Reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.

Successful Save

- Pull it 5 feet toward the center.
- Its Speed is not reduced.

Forced movement stops at the nearest legal space.

Tidal Path

Allies you choose inside the field:

- Ignore its Difficult Terrain.
- Gain a Swim Speed equal to their walking Speed.
- May move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks at the start of their turns.

A creature can use Tidal Path once per turn.

Drown the Flame

A Fire-tagged persistent area whose Source CL is lower than yours is suppressed inside Moon’s Pull.

Against an equal or higher Source CL:

- Make a Cultivation Check against its save DC when the areas first overlap.
- On a success, suppress it in the overlap.
- On a failure, both effects remain active.

An instantaneous Fire effect is not suppressed.

Cultivation Level 14 - Fivefold Organ Harmony

All five Furnaces are active simultaneously, with separate once-per-turn limits.

Normalized Procedure — Fivefold Organ Harmony

- All five Furnaces are active simultaneously. Each retains one separate once-per-turn limit; a single Stamina activation can legally trigger both Liver and Kidney, and can also trigger Spleen only if Stamina Guard or a qualifying forced-movement save occurred.

- Immunity to spoiled or ordinarily poisonous food prevents its harmful poison and contamination effects. It does not make nonfood substances edible, supply nutrition, negate curses, or neutralize an alchemical item before another creature consumes it.
- When you receive healing from one potion, pill, medicine, medicinal food, or alchemical consumable, add Constitution modifier to one healing roll made by that consumable. If it has several healing rolls, choose one after rolling but before applying healing.
- After all healing from that consumable is applied, calculate healing that exceeded missing Hit Points. Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to that excess, to a maximum of twice Proficiency Bonus. These Temporary Hit Points replace rather than stack with existing Temporary Hit Points unless another rule says otherwise.
- This benefit applies once per consumed item or dose and does not multiply healing from repeated ticks produced by the same dose.

- Activate as a Bonus Action, spend 6 Stamina, and record the 1-minute once-per-scene state. All five Furnaces remain active and their Cultivation Level 18 versions replace their normal numerical effects for the duration; the normal and improved versions do not stack.
- Heart: Once per turn on a hit, choose Fire, Radiant, or Force and add 3d8 to that hit's packet.

The reduction applies to each qualifying physical movement packet during that duration, but not teleportation.
- Refine the Impure costs 0 Stamina during the state but remains a Bonus Action and otherwise follows its complete procedure. A 0-Stamina use does not trigger Liver or Kidney because no Stamina was spent.

tianxia.subpath.body.five_viscera_immort.player_text:
Cultivation Level 6 - Refine the Impure

Bonus Action  
Cost: 2 Stamina

Choose one 

- Poisoned: Repeat the original save with Advantage. Success ends it; failure suppresses it until the start of your next turn.
- Disease: Make a Constitution save against its printed DC. Success suppresses active penalties for 24 hours. Three successes against the same disease end it; failures do not erase successes.
- Ongoing Acid or Poison: Repeat its save with Advantage. Success ends it; failure reduces its next damage by 2d8 + Constitution modifier.
- Contaminated Substance: End one temporary numerical penalty directly caused by consumed poison, spoiled medicine, contaminated food, or ordinary alchemical substance.

Cannot remove Exhaustion, Hidden Injuries, Foundation damage, Tribulation scars, curses, possession, permanent corruption, or an effect tagged Curse, Tribulation, Foundation Injury, or Permanent.

Normalized Procedure — Refine the Impure

- Choose one effect currently affecting you, spend the Bonus Action and 2 Stamina, and resolve only its matching option. Refine the Impure is a bodily purification procedure, not general dispelling or exorcism.
- Poisoned: Use the original save and DC that imposed the Poisoned condition. If no save was printed, make a Constitution save against the source's Cultivation Save DC or its fallback Authority DC. Success ends that one Poisoned condition. Failure suppresses only that condition's effects until the start of your next turn; its duration continues.
- Disease: Make a Constitution save against the printed disease DC or fallback Authority DC. Record successes separately for each disease. A success suppresses that disease's active penalties for 24 hours and adds one success; three total successes end it. Failure adds no consequence and erases no successes. A new infection is a new record unless the disease says otherwise.
- Ongoing Acid or Poison: Repeat the save printed by one ongoing Acid- or Poison-damage effect. If none exists, make a Constitution save against its source DC. Success ends that effect. Failure reduces only its next damage packet by 2d8 + Constitution modifier, to a minimum of 0; after that packet the reduction expires.
- Contaminated Substance: End one temporary numerical penalty directly and solely caused by consumed poison, spoiled medicine, contaminated food, or an ordinary alchemical substance. This can end a penalty to AC, Speed, an ability check, attack roll, save, damage roll, or maximum Hit Points only when the source explicitly identifies that numerical penalty. It does not end damage, a condition, disease, curse, addiction, beneficial tradeoff, or the source item itself.
- The printed exclusions remain absolute. An effect carrying any excluded tag is not eligible merely because it also uses Poison or Disease language.
- Repeated use can attempt the same effect again on later turns. Stamina and the Bonus Action are spent whether the save succeeds or fails.

Cultivation Level 3 - Titan's Frame

Bonus Action  
Duration: 1 minute  
Cost: 2 Stamina

Increase your size by one category, to a maximum of Large.

For the duration:

- Gain Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws.
- Count as one size larger for Grappling, Shoving, carrying, dragging, lifting, and pushing.
- Double your carrying, dragging, lifting, and pushing capacity.
- Your Iron Fist damage die becomes 1d10.
- Your reach does not increase unless another feature states otherwise.

Once during each of your turns after you hit with a Body Refining melee attack, choose one:

- Push the target 5 feet.
- Move 5 feet toward the target without provoking Opportunity Attacks from it.
- Gain Advantage on your next attempt to Grapple or Shove that target before the end of the turn.

Activating Titan's Frame again refreshes its duration but does not increase your size further.

Normalized Procedure — Titan's Frame

- Transformation record. Titan's Frame is a temporary size transformation. It changes occupied space, size-dependent reach only where printed, carrying capacity, and equipment fit under Body Refining Shared Procedures. It does not create extra limbs, attacks, Hit Dice, or inherent weapon reach.
- Legal space. You can activate the feature only if the new size can occupy your current space. If the available space permits Large but not a later Huge increase, you grow only to the largest legal printed size. A space that becomes too small after you enter it does not crush you; you are Squeezing under the normal rules until you leave or the transformation ends.
- Existing size effects. Determine your actual size after all replacement effects, then apply each distinct “count as larger” permission only to the listed operations. Titan's Frame does not stack with itself. A later activation refreshes the duration and may select a different legal size at Cultivation Level 14.
- Once-turn rider. The rider triggers after the hit resolves. The movement toward the target must end closer to it and in a legal space. The Advantage option expires at the end of the same turn and applies to only the next Grapple or Shove attempt against that target.
- Ending the form. When the form ends, return to your normal recorded size in your current space. If that space is illegal for the returning size, use Failed Spatial Movement to place you in the nearest legal space; no damage occurs unless another rule prints it.

tianxia.subpath.body.flesh_crucible.feat.player_text:
Cultivation Level 14 - Titanic Frame

Titan's Frame gains the following improvements:

- It may increase you directly to Large or Huge.
- Your Iron Fist damage die becomes 1d12.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your CL when you activate it.
- Your carrying, dragging, lifting, and pushing capacity is quadrupled rather than doubled.
- You may Grapple creatures up to two sizes larger than you.
- Gain Advantage on saving throws against being pushed, pulled, or knocked Prone.

While Mountain-Demon Might is active:

- Your Iron Fist damage becomes 2d8 before modifiers.
- You may become Huge even if you began Small.
- A creature no more than one size larger than you does not gain size-based protection against your Grapples, Shoves, or forced movement.

Normalized Procedure — Titanic Frame

- When activating Titan's Frame, choose Large or Huge, subject to legal space. The choice is a direct replacement; you do not need to pass through an intermediate size or pay more Stamina.
- “Count as one additional size larger” from Mountain-Demon Might is a functional permission for Grappling and Shoving only. It does not enlarge occupied space, reach, natural weapon damage, or carrying capacity beyond the values already printed.
- If another rule changes Iron Fist to a larger damage expression, use the largest applicable replacement unless a rule expressly says the expressions stack. The 2d8 Mountain-Demon expression is a replacement, not 1d12 + 2d8.
- The Temporary Hit Points granted by ordinary Titan's Frame and Mountain-Demon Might are separate grants but still follow the normal nonstacking Temporary Hit Point rule.

tianxia.subpath.body.flesh_crucible.feat.player_text:
Cultivation Level 18 - World-Shaking Stomp

Action  
Area: 30-foot cone  
Cost: 6 Stamina  
Saving Throw: Dexterity

On a failed save, a creature takes 10d6 Bludgeoning, Force, or Thunder damage, falls Prone, and is pushed 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, it takes half damage, remains standing, and is pushed 5 feet.

The ground in the cone becomes Difficult Terrain until cleared or repaired. Unattended objects, temporary barriers, vehicles, structures, terrain sections, and Formation Anchors take double damage.

If you are Huge when you activate this feature, its cone becomes 40 feet.

Normalized Procedure — World-Shaking Stomp

- Choose Bludgeoning, Force, or Thunder when you activate the feature; all damage from that activation uses the chosen type.
- The cone originates from your space and requires line of effect. It affects creatures and eligible objects in the area once each.
- Forced movement is directly away from you along the shortest legal route. A creature that cannot move the full distance moves as far as legally possible. No collision damage occurs unless another rule expressly creates it.
- The Difficult Terrain applies only to ordinary ground, floors, or structural surfaces physically struck by the effect. It does not alter open air, incorporeal terrain, an artifact surface, or a higher-authority area unless the governing rule permits it.
- “Double damage” is applied once to the listed unattended targets after Resistance, Immunity, Damage Threshold, and other modifiers in the universal damage procedure. A Formation Anchor that is also a structure is not doubled twice.

---

tianxia.subpath.body.goruden.feature.gol.player_text:
Cultivation Level 14 - Golden Aura

Bonus Action  
Area: 10-foot aura centered on you  
Duration: 1 minute  
Cost: 5 Stamina  
Limit: Once per scene

For the duration, you and allies of your choice in the aura gain Advantage on saving throws against Frightened, Resistance to Necrotic damage, and Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus the first time they enter the aura or start a turn there during the activation.

A hostile creature that starts its turn in the aura makes a Wisdom saving throw.

- Failed Save: Choose Disadvantage on its next attack, inability to benefit from Invisible, or no Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- Successful Save: It cannot benefit from Invisible until the start of its next turn.

Normalized Procedure — Golden Aura
- The aura moves with you and extends 10 feet from your current space. You choose whether each ally is included whenever that ally would receive a benefit; no action is required.
- Each chosen ally gains the Temporary Hit Points only once per activation: the first time it enters the aura or starts a turn there. Leaving and re-entering does not grant them again during the same activation.
- Advantage against Frightened and Necrotic Resistance apply while the chosen ally is in the aura. They end immediately upon leaving, though already gained Temporary Hit Points remain.
- Each hostile creature that starts its turn in the aura makes one Wisdom save. Choose its failed-save result after it fails. The “next attack” Disadvantage is expended whether the attack hits or misses. Named effects from this aura refresh rather than stack.
- Invisible denial removes the condition's benefits for the printed duration. It does not automatically expose a creature behind cover or identify an illusion not based on Invisible.
- If the aura is suppressed, its duration and scene use continue; it grants no benefits while dormant.

tianxia.subpath.body.goruden.feature.imm.player_text:
Cultivation Level 18 - Immortal Gold

You can use this when  You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but are not killed outright.  
Cost: 6 Stamina  
Limit: Once per scene  
Action: None

You are reduced to 1 Hit Point instead and become a golden statue until the start of your next turn.

While transformed:

- You are Incapacitated.
- Your Speed is 0.
- You cannot take actions or Reactions.
- Gain Resistance to all damage.
- Gain Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.
- You remain aware of your surroundings.
- An effect whose Source CL is lower than yours cannot move you.

At the start of your next turn:

- Regain Hit Points equal to 5 x Proficiency Bonus.
- End the statue transformation.
- Activate Golden Aura without paying its cost or expending its use.
- Take your turn normally.

An equal- or higher-CL effect may move the statue by winning an opposed Cultivation Check.

Only one feature that prevents or replaces the same reduction to 0 Hit Points may resolve.

tianxia.subpath.body.goruden.feature.rad.player_text:
Cultivation Level 10 - Radiant Fist

Your unarmed strikes may deal Radiant damage.

Once per turn when you hit with an unarmed strike, choose one:

- Deal additional Radiant damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- Cause the target to shed Dim Light in a 10-foot radius until the start of your next turn.
- Prevent the target from benefiting from Invisible until the start of your next turn.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Against Undead, Fiends, creatures with the Daemonic tag, or active daemonic corruption, the additional Radiant damage becomes twice your Proficiency Bonus.

Normalized Procedure — Radiant Fist
- Choose the damage type of each unarmed strike when making it. Radiant replaces, rather than adds to, its ordinary damage type.
- Once per turn after an unarmed hit, choose exactly one rider. The additional damage is Radiant. The light is centered on the target and moves with it. Invisible denial suppresses the benefits of the Invisible condition but does not reveal a hidden target's exact location through total cover or another concealment. Temporary Hit Points follow ordinary nonstacking rules.
- If the target is Undead, Fiend, has the Daemonic tag, or bears an active daemonic corruption, only the additional Radiant-damage rider increases from Proficiency Bonus to twice Proficiency Bonus. The other three options are unchanged.
- A target meeting several qualifying categories receives the doubled value only once.

tianxia.subpath.body.heaven_answering_ad.player_text:
Cultivation Level 3 - Flesh Remembers Pain

Once per round after qualifying hostile damage, choose one valid type in the packet. Gain a Damage Adaptation until scene end.

At Cultivation Level 3, maintain one; a new one replaces it.

While adapted:

- Reduce the first instance of that damage each round by Proficiency Bonus.
- You know when an effect about to damage you includes that type.

Reaction  
You can use this when  You take adapted damage.  
Cost: 1 Stamina  
Limit: Once per round

Gain Resistance to that type against the triggering packet.

Normalized Procedure — Flesh Remembers Pain

- After one qualifying hostile damage event resolves and applies at least 1 damage of a valid type to your Hit Points, choose one valid type present and gain its Adaptation. This acquisition can occur once per round.
- At Cultivation Level 3, if another Damage Adaptation is already maintained, choose whether the new record replaces it. Declining the new record is legal.
- The first instance reduction applies to the first packet each round that would apply at least 1 damage of that type after percentage modifiers. Reduce that type's portion by Proficiency Bonus at the shared flat-reduction step, to a minimum of 0. It is then spent for the round even if the portion becomes 0.
- The Reaction is declared when an adapted damage packet is about to be applied, after the packet and type are known but before Resistance and Hit Point loss are finalized. Spend 1 Stamina and gain Resistance to that type for the triggering packet only.
- The Reaction and the Adaptation's flat reduction can apply to the same packet: apply Resistance first under normal damage ordering, then the flat reduction. Immunity or a canceled packet does not require or consume the Reaction.
- The once-per-round acquisition limit, first-instance reduction, and Reaction limit are separate records.

tianxia.subpath.body.heaven_answering_ad.player_text:
Cultivation Level 6 - Meridians Remember Affliction

Once per round after failing a save and becoming Blinded, Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Restrained, or Stunned, record it as your Affliction Adaptation until scene end. Maintain one.

While affected by the adapted condition:

- Add Proficiency Bonus to saves made to end it.
- If no save is normally allowed during your turn, spend 2 Stamina at the end of your turn to repeat the original save against the original DC, once per round.

Normalized Procedure — Meridians Remember Affliction

- Gain an Affliction Adaptation only after failing a hostile save and actually becoming one of the listed conditions. Several eligible conditions from one failed save create one chosen Adaptation.
- Acquisition occurs once per round. At the current one-record limit, a new record can replace the existing one or be declined.
- Add Proficiency Bonus to every save made specifically to end the adapted condition, including repeat saves printed by its source. This bonus does not apply to the initial save that created the Adaptation.
- When the condition normally grants no save during your turn, at the end of your turn you may spend 2 Stamina to repeat the original save using the original ability and DC. This can occur once per round.
- A successful repeat ends only the adapted condition and failure-only ongoing functions directly dependent on it. It does not reverse damage, movement, consumed resources, a completed transformation, or another condition unless its Source Rule links them.
- If the original source no longer exists, use its recorded DC. If no valid original DC was recorded, use the fallback Authority DC for its Realm.

tianxia.subpath.body.heaven_answering_ad.player_text:
Cultivation Level 10 - Return the Lesson

You can use this when  You hit a creature that dealt your adapted damage type to you or imposed your adapted condition during the current scene.  
Cost: 1 Stamina  
Limit: Once per turn

Deal an additional 2d8 Force damage and choose one:

- Push 10 feet.
- No Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- Speed 0 until the start of its next turn.
- Disadvantage on its next save against one of your Body Refining features before the end of your next turn.
- Move 10 feet without provoking.

Normalized Procedure — Return the Lesson

- Every Adaptation records the creature that dealt the adapted damage or imposed the adapted condition. A creature qualifies if it appears in at least one maintained record from the current scene.
- Declare after hitting a qualifying creature. Spend 1 Stamina, add 2d8 Force to that hit, and choose one printed result. This can occur once per turn.
- Push is directly away from you and follows forced-movement rules. Reaction denial begins after the hit and lasts until the start of the target's next turn. Speed 0 uses the same duration.
- For the save penalty, name one Body Refining feature you possess when applying the rider. The target has Disadvantage on its next save against that named feature before the end of your next turn; the rider expires after that save or at the stated time.
- The movement option moves you up to 10 feet without provoking after the hit resolves. It is physical movement along a legal route.
- Environmental hazards, unattended objects, and effects without a source creature can create Adaptations but cannot be targets of Return the Lesson unless they are represented by a legal creature.

tianxia.subpath.body.heaven_answering_ad.player_text:
Cultivation Level 14 - Ten Thousand Answers

Maintain three Damage Adaptations and two Affliction Adaptations.

Gain automatic Resistance to adapted Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing, and Thunder damage.

Force and Psychic Adaptations instead reduce the first instance each round by twice Proficiency Bonus. Flesh Remembers Pain may still grant Resistance to Force or Psychic against one packet.

Normalized Procedure — Ten Thousand Answers

- Increase maintained capacities to three different Damage Adaptations and two different Affliction Adaptations. When a new record exceeds capacity, choose one record of the same category to replace or decline the new record.
- For Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing, and Thunder, the maintained Adaptation grants Resistance continuously until scene end.
- For Force and Psychic, replace the Cultivation Level 3 first-instance reduction with twice Proficiency Bonus. Do not add both the Proficiency Bonus and twice-Proficiency-Bonus reductions.
- Flesh Remembers Pain's Reaction remains legal against Force or Psychic and can grant packet-only Resistance before the twice-Proficiency-Bonus reduction. It is redundant for types already receiving automatic Resistance but can still be declared if another rule would temporarily remove that Resistance.
- Several maintained Adaptations do not combine against one type or create double Resistance.

tianxia.subpath.body.heaven_binding_chai.player_text:
Cultivation Level 3 - Chain-Body Integration

Gain proficiency with Chain Weapons.

While wielding one:

- Use Constitution instead of Strength or Dexterity for attack and damage rolls.
- You may use your Cultivation Attack Modifier.
- It is integrated into Body Refining.
- Reach increases by 5 feet during your turn.
- Refined Iron Fist and Heavenly Fist apply.

This does not grant the Chains Sphere.

Meridian Tether

You can use this when  You hit with a Chain Weapon or unarmed strike.  
Cost: 1 Stamina  
Limit: Once per turn  
Saving Throw: Strength

On a failed save, the target becomes Tethered until the end of your next turn.

While Tethered:

- It cannot willingly move more than 20 feet from you.
- It cannot benefit from willing allied movement that carries it beyond 20 feet.
- Teleportation beyond 20 feet requires a Cultivation Check against your DC; failure uses Failed Spatial Movement.
- You know its direction within 60 feet.

A Tether ends if you become Unconscious, willingly end it, the target ends its turn more than 30 feet away because of hostile forced movement, or an effect severs cultivation bindings.

At Cultivation Level 3, maintain one Tether; a new one replaces it.

Normalized Procedure — Chain Integration and Meridian Tethers

- Record each qualifying Chain Weapon by weapon group. While wielding it, Constitution replaces Strength or Dexterity for its attack and damage rolls, and you may use your Cultivation Attack Modifier for its attack rolls. Integration grants no Sphere, talent, extra Chain Weapon, or independent chain manifestation.
- The 5-foot reach increase applies only during your turn. At Cultivation Level 14 the two turn-only increases combine for +10 feet during your turn; they do not enlarge threatened space outside your turn.
- Refined Iron Fist and Heavenly Fist apply only through their printed integrated-weapon interface. If several rules replace the same weapon damage die, use the highest legal replacement rather than adding several base weapon dice.
- Declare Meridian Tether after the triggering hit resolves, spend 1 Stamina, select one creature hit, and have it make one Strength save. A Tether is a cultivation restraint, not Grappled or Restrained, and it does not by itself prevent attacks, actions, forced movement, falling, or movement toward you.
- Record the Tether's source, target, Source CL, maximum distance, direction-sense range, duration, and removal conditions. At Cultivation Level 3 you can maintain one Meridian Tether; creating another immediately ends the previous one after the new target fails its save.
- A Tethered creature can willingly move within the 20-foot boundary and can move closer to you. It cannot use its own willing movement, or accept willing allied movement, to end farther than 20 feet from you. Hostile forced movement can carry it beyond that boundary.
- A willing teleport or other spatial movement that would end farther than 20 feet requires one Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC before movement occurs. On failure use Failed Spatial Movement; on success the movement resolves normally unless another feature intervenes.
- Direction sense functions only while the target is within 60 feet and on the same plane. It gives direction, not exact distance, condition, identity through disguise, line of sight, or permission to target through total cover.
- The Tether ends at its printed duration, when you become Unconscious, when you willingly end it without an action, when a legal effect severs cultivation bindings, or when the target ends its turn more than 30 feet from you after hostile forced movement. Being momentarily farther than 30 feet before that end-of-turn check does not end it.
